source.text: וַיִּתְחַזֵּ֛ק שְׁלֹמֹ֥ה בֶן־דָּוִ֖יד עַל־מַלְכוּת֑וֹ וַיהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהָיו֙ עִמּ֔וֹ וַֽיְגַדְּלֵ֖הוּ לְמָֽעְלָה׃

records.literal_gloss: And strengthened himself Solomon son of David over his kingdom, and Yahweh his God [was] with him and made him great upward.

en.L: And Solomon son of David strengthened himself over his kingdom, and {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} his God [was] with him and made him exceedingly great.
en.B: Solomon son of David established himself firmly over his kingdom. {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} his God was with him and made him very great.
en.R: Solomon, David's son, took firm control of his kingdom. {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} his God was with him and made him a very great king.

es.L: Y se fortaleció Salomón hijo de David en su reino, y {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} su Dios [estaba] con él y lo engrandeció en gran manera.
es.B: Salomón hijo de David se afirmó en su reino. {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} su Dios estaba con él y lo hizo muy grande.
es.R: Salomón, hijo de David, tomó el control firme de su reino. {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} su Dios estaba con él y lo hizo un rey muy poderoso.

fr.L: Et Salomon fils de David s’affermit sur son royaume, et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} son Dieu [était] avec lui et le rendit extrêmement grand.
fr.B: Salomon, fils de David, s’établit fermement sur son royaume. {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} son Dieu était avec lui et le rendit très grand.
fr.R: Salomon, le fils de David, a pris fermement en main son royaume. {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} son Dieu était avec lui et a fait de lui un très grand roi.

sw.L: Sulemani mwana wa Daudi akajiimarisha juu ya ufalme wake, na {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wake [alikuwa] pamoja naye, akamfanya mkuu mno.
sw.B: Sulemani mwana wa Daudi aliuimarisha ufalme wake. {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wake alikuwa pamoja naye, akamfanya mkuu sana.
sw.R: Sulemani, mwana wa Daudi, aliushika ufalme wake kwa uthabiti. {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wake alikuwa pamoja naye, akamfanya kuwa mfalme mkuu sana.

vi.L: Sa-lô-môn con trai Đa-vít làm cho mình vững mạnh trên vương quốc mình, và {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của vua [ở] với vua và làm cho vua rất lớn mạnh.
vi.B: Sa-lô-môn con trai Đa-vít củng cố vững chắc quyền cai trị trên vương quốc mình. {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của vua ở với vua và làm cho vua trở nên rất hùng mạnh.
vi.R: Sa-lô-môn, con trai Đa-vít, nắm vững quyền cai trị vương quốc. {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của vua ở với vua và làm cho vua trở thành một vị vua rất vĩ đại.

ko.L: 그리고 다윗의 아들 솔로몬이 자기 나라 위에 자신을 강하게 했고, {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 그의 하나님께서 그와 함께 [계셔서] 그를 매우 크게 하셨다.
ko.B: 다윗의 아들 솔로몬은 자기 나라를 굳게 다스리게 되었다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 그의 하나님께서 그와 함께 계셔서 그를 매우 위대하게 하셨다.
ko.R: 다윗의 아들 솔로몬은 나라를 든든하게 다스렸다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 그의 하나님께서 그와 함께 계셔서 그를 아주 위대한 왕이 되게 하셨다.

pt.L: E Salomão, filho de Davi, se fortaleceu sobre o seu reino, e {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o seu Deus, [estava] com ele e o engrandeceu sobremaneira.
pt.B: Salomão, filho de Davi, se firmou no seu reino. {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}}, o seu Deus, estava com ele e o tornou muito grande.
pt.R: Salomão, filho de Davi, assumiu o controle firme do seu reino. {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}}, o seu Deus, estava com ele e fez dele um rei muito grande.

decisions.choice: strengthened himself over his kingdom: made his rule secure
decisions.reason: The verb means to grow strong or to take a firm hold. Said of a new king, it means that he made his hold on the kingdom secure (compare 12:13; 13:21). Kings says the same in other words: "the kingdom was established in the hand of Solomon" (1 Kings 2:12, 46).

decisions.choice: the story goes on from 1 Chronicles 29
decisions.reason: 1 Chronicles ends with Solomon made king a second time, sitting on Yahweh's throne, and Yahweh making him exceedingly great (1 Chronicles 29:22-25). 2 Chronicles begins where that leaves off. It does not tell the struggle for the throne and the deaths that secured it, which Kings tells (1 Kings 1-2).

decisions.choice: Yahweh his God was with him and made him great: Solomon's greatness is God's gift
decisions.reason: The verse gives the credit for Solomon's rise to Yahweh. "Yahweh was with him" was said of David too (1 Chronicles 11:9; 17:2, 8), and "made him great upward" means "made him exceedingly great", as in 1 Chronicles 29:25.

decisions.choice: made him a very great king
decisions.reason: Readable adds "king" so that it is clear that Solomon's greatness as a ruler is meant.

decisions.choice: "se fortaleció" (L); "se afirmó" (B); "tomó el control firme" (R)
decisions.reason: The verb is the reflexive "strengthened himself" of a new king securing his rule (meaning decision); Spanish keeps the reflexive at Literal and says what it meant at Balanced and Readable.

decisions.choice: "lo hizo un rey muy poderoso"
decisions.reason: As the English Readable, "great" is said of Solomon as king.

decisions.choice: passé simple for narration at L and B, passé composé at R
decisions.reason: As the French style guide (section 3) and the Kings and Chronicles terms note set out, for this block of chapters (2 Chronicles 1-19): the passé simple is the normal tense of written narrative, used at Literal and Balanced; Readable uses the passé composé. Speech keeps the tenses of speech at every level, and repeated action is in the imparfait. Where Chronicles retells Kings with the same Hebrew, the French Kings wording is reused at each level.

decisions.choice: akajiimarisha juu ya ufalme wake
decisions.reason: Swahili has a reflexive verb, "kujiimarisha", that keeps the Hebrew's "strengthened himself"; Balanced and Readable say what it means, that he made his rule firm (m1).

decisions.choice: "củng cố vững chắc quyền cai trị" (B); "nắm vững quyền cai trị" (R)
decisions.reason: The verb is reflexive, "made himself strong"; said of a new king it means he made his rule secure (m1). Literal keeps "làm cho mình vững mạnh"; Balanced and Readable say what it meant.

decisions.choice: Narrative in the plain written style (했다); the honorific -시- for God only (함께 계셔서, 하셨다)
decisions.reason: The book-wide narrative style of the Korean drafts of Samuel and Kings, kept through Chronicles; years, ages and numbers in figures as in 1 Kings.

decisions.choice: se fortaleceu (L); se firmou (B); assumiu o controle firme (R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the verb's picture of growing strong; Balanced and Readable say what it means for a new king (m1), with the word "firme" that 1 Kings 2:12 and 2:46 use in Portuguese for the same fact ("o reino ficou firme nas mãos de Salomão"). This book's Portuguese follows the wording of 1-2 Kings wherever Chronicles retells it, level by level, and records the parallel.

source.text: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר שְׁלֹמֹ֣ה לְכָל־יִשְׂרָאֵ֡ל לְשָׂרֵי֩ הָאֲלָפִ֨ים וְהַמֵּא֜וֹת וְלַשֹּֽׁפְטִ֗ים וּלְכֹ֛ל נָשִׂ֥יא לְכָל־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל רָאשֵׁ֥י הָאָבֽוֹת׃

records.literal_gloss: And spoke Solomon to all Israel, to [the] commanders of the thousands and the hundreds, and to the judges, and to every leader in all Israel, [the] heads of the fathers.

en.L: And Solomon spoke to all Israel, to the commanders of the thousands and of the hundreds, and to the judges, and to every leader in all Israel, the heads of the fathers.
en.B: Solomon addressed all Israel: the commanders over thousands and over hundreds, the judges, and every leader in all Israel, the heads of families.
en.R: Solomon called on all the people of Israel to come with him. He spoke to the commanders over thousands and over hundreds of soldiers, to the judges, and to all the leaders in Israel, the heads of the families.

es.L: Y habló Salomón a todo Israel, a los jefes de millares y de centenas, y a los jueces, y a todo príncipe de todo Israel, jefes de las casas paternas.
es.B: Salomón habló a todo Israel: a los jefes de mil y de cien soldados, a los jueces y a todos los dirigentes de Israel, los jefes de familia.
es.R: Salomón llamó a todo el pueblo de Israel para que fuera con él. Habló a los jefes de mil y de cien soldados, a los jueces y a todos los dirigentes de Israel, los jefes de las familias.

fr.L: Et Salomon parla à tout Israël, aux chefs des milliers et des centaines, et aux juges, et à chaque prince dans tout Israël, les chefs des pères.
fr.B: Salomon s’adressa à tout Israël : aux chefs de milliers et de centaines, aux juges et à tous les dirigeants de tout Israël, les chefs de famille.
fr.R: Salomon a appelé tout le peuple d’Israël à venir avec lui. Il a parlé aux chefs de milliers et de centaines de soldats, aux juges et à tous les dirigeants d’Israël, les chefs des familles.

sw.L: Sulemani akasema na Israeli wote, na wakuu wa maelfu na wa mamia, na waamuzi, na kila kiongozi katika Israeli wote, wakuu wa mababa.
sw.B: Sulemani alizungumza na Israeli wote: makamanda wa maelfu na wa mamia, waamuzi, na kila kiongozi katika Israeli yote, wakuu wa jamaa.
sw.R: Sulemani aliwaita watu wote wa Israeli waende pamoja naye. Alizungumza na makamanda wa vikosi vya askari elfu na vya askari mia, na waamuzi, na viongozi wote wa Israeli, wakuu wa jamaa.

vi.L: Sa-lô-môn nói với toàn thể Y-sơ-ra-ên, với các chỉ huy hàng ngàn và hàng trăm, với các thẩm phán, và với mọi thủ lĩnh trong toàn thể Y-sơ-ra-ên, những người đứng đầu các tổ phụ.
vi.B: Sa-lô-môn truyền gọi toàn thể Y-sơ-ra-ên: các chỉ huy ngàn quân và trăm quân, các thẩm phán, và mọi thủ lĩnh trong toàn thể Y-sơ-ra-ên, tức các trưởng gia tộc.
vi.R: Sa-lô-môn kêu gọi toàn dân Y-sơ-ra-ên đi cùng vua. Vua nói với các chỉ huy ngàn quân và trăm quân, với các thẩm phán, và với tất cả những người lãnh đạo trong Y-sơ-ra-ên, là những người đứng đầu các gia đình.

ko.L: 그리고 솔로몬이 온 이스라엘, 곧 천부장들과 백부장들과 재판관들과 온 이스라엘의 모든 지도자, 곧 가문의 우두머리들에게 말했다.
ko.B: 솔로몬이 온 이스라엘, 곧 천부장과 백부장과 재판관들과 온 이스라엘의 모든 지도자인 각 가문의 우두머리들에게 말했다.
ko.R: 솔로몬은 이스라엘 온 백성에게 자기와 함께 가자고 했다. 그는 군인 천 명을 거느린 지휘관과 백 명을 거느린 지휘관들, 재판관들, 그리고 이스라엘의 모든 지도자, 곧 각 집안의 어른들에게 말했다.

pt.L: E Salomão falou a todo o Israel, aos chefes dos milhares e das centenas, e aos juízes, e a todo líder em todo o Israel, os chefes das famílias.
pt.B: Salomão falou a todo o Israel: aos comandantes de mil e de cem, aos juízes e a todos os líderes de todo o Israel, os chefes das famílias.
pt.R: Salomão convocou todo o povo de Israel para ir com ele. Ele falou aos comandantes das tropas de mil e de cem soldados, aos juízes e a todos os líderes de Israel, os líderes das famílias.

decisions.choice: spoke to all Israel: called them together
decisions.reason: The verb is the common word for "say" or "speak". Here no words are quoted: what follows (verse 3) shows that Solomon called the people's leaders to go with him to Gibeon. David had gathered the leaders in the same way to bring up the ark (1 Chronicles 13:1-5).

decisions.choice: commanders of thousands and of hundreds: the army's officers
decisions.reason: Israel's fighting men were organized in units of a thousand and of a hundred, each under its commander (1 Chronicles 13:1; 27:1). The list names the army's officers, the judges and the heads of the families: the people's whole leadership stands for "all Israel".

decisions.choice: heads of the fathers: the heads of the families
decisions.reason: "House of the fathers" is the family line; its "heads" are the senior men of each family, who spoke for it. The phrase sums up the leaders just named.

decisions.choice: commanders (all levels); leader; heads of the fathers (Literal), heads of families (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: The wording kept for these words in these books. Readable adds "of soldiers" so that the units are clear.

decisions.choice: called on all the people of Israel to come with him
decisions.reason: Readable says what Solomon's speaking was for (m1), which verse 3 shows.

decisions.choice: "jefes de las casas paternas" (L); "jefes de familia" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew "heads of the fathers" are the senior men of each family line (meaning decision); Literal keeps the father's house, Balanced and Readable say "families", as the English does.

decisions.choice: "prince" (L), "dirigeants" (B, R); "les chefs des pères" (L), "les chefs de famille" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The leader (*nasi*) is "prince" at Literal, as in French Kings (1 Kings 11:34); Balanced and Readable say "dirigeants", the general word the English "leader" calls for. "Heads of the fathers" is kept at Literal and said plainly as heads of families above it.

decisions.choice: wakuu wa mababa (Literal); wakuu wa jamaa (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: "Heads of the fathers" are the senior men of each family (m3). Literal keeps "mababa"; Balanced and Readable say "jamaa", the family, the word kept for "father's house" in the Swahili Pentateuch.

decisions.choice: "천부장", "백부장" (L, B); "군인 천 명을 거느린 지휘관" (R); "가문의 우두머리" (L, B), "집안의 어른" (R)
decisions.reason: The established Korean titles for commanders of thousands and hundreds; Readable spells out what they command, as the English Readable adds "of soldiers".

decisions.choice: "những người đứng đầu các tổ phụ" (L); "các trưởng gia tộc" (B); "những người đứng đầu các gia đình" (R)
decisions.reason: "Heads of the fathers" are the senior men of each family line (m3). Literal keeps "fathers"; Balanced and Readable say "family". Kept for these words through Chronicles.

decisions.choice: os chefes dos milhares (L), os comandantes de mil (B), os comandantes das tropas de mil soldados (R); os chefes das famílias (L, B), os líderes das famílias (R)
decisions.reason: As 1 Chronicles 15:25 sets the army's officers (m2) and 1 Chronicles 8:6 the "heads of the fathers" (m3) in Portuguese: "famílias" at every level, since a word-for-word "chefes dos pais" would mean heads of parents.

source.text: וַיֵּלְכ֗וּ שְׁלֹמֹה֙ וְכָל־הַקָּהָ֣ל עִמּ֔וֹ לַבָּמָ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּגִבְע֑וֹן כִּי־שָׁ֣ם הָיָ֗ה אֹ֤הֶל מוֹעֵד֙ הָֽאֱלֹהִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשָׂ֛ה מֹשֶׁ֥ה עֶֽבֶד־יְהוָ֖ה בַּמִּדְבָּֽר׃

records.literal_gloss: And went Solomon and all the assembly with him to the high place that [was] at Gibeon, for there was [the] tent of meeting of God which made Moses [the] servant of Yahweh in the wilderness.

en.L: And Solomon and all the assembly with him went to the high place that [was] at Gibeon, for the tent of meeting of God was there, which Moses the slave of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had made in the wilderness.
en.B: Then Solomon and the whole assembly with him went to the high place at Gibeon, because God's tent of meeting was there, the one that Moses the servant of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had made in the wilderness.
en.R: Then Solomon and all the people gathered with him went to the hilltop shrine at the town of Gibeon. God's meeting tent was there, the one that Moses, {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}'s servant, had made in the wilderness.

es.L: Y fue Salomón, y toda la asamblea con él, al lugar alto que [estaba] en Gabaón, porque allí estaba la Tienda del Encuentro de Dios, que Moisés siervo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} había hecho en el desierto.
es.B: Entonces Salomón y toda la asamblea con él fueron al lugar alto de Gabaón, porque allí estaba la Tienda del Encuentro de Dios, la que Moisés, siervo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, había hecho en el desierto.
es.R: Entonces Salomón y todo el pueblo reunido con él fueron al santuario sobre la colina, en el pueblo de Gabaón. Allí estaba la Tienda del Encuentro de Dios, la que Moisés, siervo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, había hecho en el desierto.

fr.L: Et Salomon, et toute l’assemblée avec lui, allèrent au haut lieu qui [était] à Gabaon, car là était la tente de la Rencontre de Dieu, que Moïse, serviteur {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, avait faite dans le désert.
fr.B: Puis Salomon et toute l’assemblée avec lui se rendirent au haut lieu de Gabaon, car c’est là que se trouvait la tente de la Rencontre de Dieu, celle que Moïse, serviteur {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, avait faite dans le désert.
fr.R: Ensuite, Salomon et tous ceux qui s’étaient réunis avec lui sont allés au sanctuaire sur la colline, dans la ville de Gabaon. C’est là que se trouvait la tente de la Rencontre de Dieu, celle que Moïse, le serviteur {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, avait fabriquée dans le désert.

sw.L: Sulemani na kusanyiko lote pamoja naye wakaenda mahali pa juu palipokuwa Gibeoni, kwa maana Hema la Kukutania la Mungu lilikuwa huko, ambalo Musa mtumishi wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alilitengeneza jangwani.
sw.B: Kisha Sulemani na kusanyiko lote pamoja naye walikwenda mahali pa juu huko Gibeoni, kwa sababu Hema la Kukutania la Mungu lilikuwa huko, lile ambalo Musa mtumishi wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alilitengeneza jangwani.
sw.R: Kisha Sulemani na watu wote waliokusanyika pamoja naye walikwenda katika patakatifu pa kilimani katika mji wa Gibeoni. Hema la Kukutania la Mungu lilikuwa huko, lile ambalo Musa, mtumishi wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, alilitengeneza jangwani.

vi.L: Sa-lô-môn và cả hội chúng với vua đi đến nơi cao [ở] tại Ga-ba-ôn, vì Lều Hội Kiến của Đức Chúa Trời ở đó, [lều] mà Môi-se đầy tớ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã làm trong hoang mạc.
vi.B: Rồi Sa-lô-môn và cả hội chúng cùng đi với vua đến nơi cao tại Ga-ba-ôn, vì Lều Hội Kiến của Đức Chúa Trời ở đó, là lều mà Môi-se đầy tớ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã làm trong hoang mạc.
vi.R: Rồi Sa-lô-môn và mọi người đã tụ họp với vua đi đến nơi thờ phượng trên đồi cao tại thành Ga-ba-ôn. Lều Hội Kiến của Đức Chúa Trời ở đó, là cái lều mà Môi-se, đầy tớ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, đã làm trong hoang mạc.

ko.L: 그리고 솔로몬과 그와 함께한 온 회중이 기브온에 있는 산당으로 갔다. 하나님의 회막이 거기 있었기 때문이다. 그것은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 종 모세가 광야에서 만든 것이었다.
ko.B: 그리고 솔로몬과 그와 함께한 온 회중은 기브온에 있는 산당으로 갔다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 종 모세가 광야에서 만든 하나님의 회막이 거기 있었기 때문이다.
ko.R: 그리고 솔로몬과 그와 함께 모인 모든 사람은 기브온 성읍에 있는 산꼭대기 제단으로 갔다. 회막이 거기 있었기 때문이다. 그 장막은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 종 모세가 광야에서 만든 것이었다.

pt.L: E Salomão e toda a assembleia com ele foram ao alto que [estava] em Gibeom, porque ali estava a tenda do encontro de Deus, que Moisés, escravo {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, tinha feito no deserto.
pt.B: Então Salomão e toda a assembleia com ele foram ao alto de Gibeom, porque ali estava a tenda do encontro de Deus, aquela que Moisés, servo {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, tinha feito no deserto.
pt.R: Então Salomão e todo o povo reunido com ele foram ao santuário no alto do morro, na cidade de Gibeom. Ali estava a tenda do encontro de Deus, a mesma que Moisés, o servo {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, tinha feito no deserto.

decisions.choice: the visit to Gibeon told in 1 Kings 3:4
decisions.reason: 1 Kings 3:4 says that the king went to Gibeon to sacrifice, "because it was the great high place". Chronicles tells the same visit with differences: the whole assembly goes with Solomon, and the reason given is that the tent of meeting Moses made was at Gibeon. It leaves out the remark that the people and Solomon were still sacrificing at the high places (1 Kings 3:2-3).

decisions.choice: the tent of meeting at Gibeon: the tabernacle of the wilderness
decisions.reason: The tent of meeting is the tabernacle Moses made at Sinai (Exodus 33:7; 40:2). By David's time it stood at the high place at Gibeon, a few miles northwest of Jerusalem, and the priests served at its altar there (1 Chronicles 16:39-40; 21:29). That is why Gibeon was the chief place of worship.

decisions.choice: Moses the servant of Yahweh: a title of honor
decisions.reason: The word is the one used for a slave, a person who belongs to a master. As a title for Moses it is an honor: he belonged to Yahweh and served him (Deuteronomy 34:5; 1 Chronicles 6:34).

decisions.choice: high place (Literal, Balanced), hilltop shrine (Readable); tent of meeting (Literal, Balanced), meeting tent (Readable); slave (Literal), servant (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: The wording kept for these words in these books, as in 1 Kings 3:4.

decisions.choice: "la Tienda del Encuentro"
decisions.reason: The Spanish Pentateuch calls the tent of meeting "la Tienda del Encuentro" (Exodus 40:2); Chronicles keeps the published name at every level.

decisions.choice: "siervo" for Moses at every level
decisions.reason: The English Literal says "slave" (r-en-1); as in the Spanish Kings, God's servants (Moses, David, the prophets) are "siervo" at every level, a title of honor (meaning decision).

decisions.choice: "la tente de la Rencontre" (every level); "serviteur" for Moses (every level)
decisions.reason: The tent's name in the French Pentateuch and French Kings, plain enough for Readable. A named servant of God (Moses, David) is "serviteur" at every level, Literal included, as in French Kings; the English Literal says "slave".

decisions.choice: mtumishi (all levels)
decisions.reason: As in the Swahili Kings and Samuel drafts, the LORD's named servants (Moses, David, the prophets) are "mtumishi" at every level, Literal included: "mtumwa" would sound like a slave bought and sold, while the title is one of honor (m3).

decisions.choice: "Môi-se đầy tớ của CHÚA" at every level
decisions.reason: Moses' title is one of honor (m3). God's servants (Moses, David, the prophets, "your servant" in prayer) are "đầy tớ" at every level of Chronicles, Literal included; "nô lệ" would make an honor sound degrading in Vietnamese.

decisions.choice: "nơi cao" (L, B), "nơi thờ phượng trên đồi cao" (R); "Lều Hội Kiến"
decisions.reason: The wording kept for these words in Kings and Chronicles, as 1 Kings 3:4 and the terms note.

decisions.choice: "산당" (L, B), "산꼭대기 제단" (R); "회막" at every level; "종" at every level
decisions.reason: The high place as in 1 Kings 3:4 and the terms note; "회막" at every level, as the Pentateuch names the tent of meeting. Korean "종" covers both slave and servant, so one word serves every level.

decisions.choice: o alto (L, B), o santuário no alto do morro (R); Gibeom; a tenda do encontro (every level); escravo (L), servo (B, R)
decisions.reason: For the whole book, as 1 Kings 3:2-4 and 8:4 in Portuguese: "o alto" is the traditional name of these shrines, explained at Readable as the English "hilltop shrine" does; the town is "Gibeom"; "a tenda do encontro" is plain enough to stay at Readable, where the English says "meeting tent"; and Moses' title (m3) follows the Old Testament terms for *ʿeved*.

source.text: אֲבָ֗ל אֲר֤וֹן הָאֱלֹהִים֙ הֶעֱלָ֤ה דָוִיד֙ מִקִּרְיַ֣ת יְעָרִ֔ים בַּֽהֵכִ֥ין ל֖וֹ דָּוִ֑יד כִּ֧י נָֽטָה־ל֛וֹ אֹ֖הֶל בִּירוּשָׁלִָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: But [the] ark of God had brought up David from Kiriath-jearim to [the place] prepared for it David, for he had pitched for it a tent in Jerusalem.

en.L: But the ark of God David had brought up from Kiriath-jearim to [the place] David had prepared for it, for he had pitched a tent for it in Jerusalem.
en.B: But David had brought the ark of God up from Kiriath-jearim to the place he had prepared, because he had pitched a tent for it in Jerusalem.
en.R: But David had already brought the ark of God, the sacred chest, up from the town of Kiriath-jearim. He had set up a tent for it in Jerusalem, in a place he had prepared for it.

es.L: Pero el arca de Dios la había subido David de Quiriat-jearim al [lugar que] David le había preparado, porque le había levantado una tienda en Jerusalén.
es.B: Pero David había subido el arca de Dios desde Quiriat-jearim al lugar que le había preparado, porque había levantado una tienda para ella en Jerusalén.
es.R: Pero David ya había llevado el arca de Dios, el cofre sagrado, desde el pueblo de Quiriat-jearim. Había levantado una tienda para ella en Jerusalén, en un lugar que le había preparado.

fr.L: Mais l’arche de Dieu, David l’avait fait monter de Qiryath-Yearim à [l’endroit que] David avait préparé pour elle, car il avait dressé pour elle une tente à Jérusalem.
fr.B: Mais David avait fait monter l’arche de Dieu de Qiryath-Yearim jusqu’à l’endroit qu’il avait préparé, car il avait dressé une tente pour elle à Jérusalem.
fr.R: Mais David avait déjà fait monter l’arche de Dieu, le coffre sacré, depuis la ville de Qiryath-Yearim. Il avait dressé une tente pour elle à Jérusalem, à un endroit qu’il avait préparé pour elle.

sw.L: Lakini sanduku la Mungu Daudi alikuwa amelipandisha kutoka Kiriath-yearimu mpaka [mahali] Daudi alipokuwa amelitayarishia, kwa maana alikuwa amelipigia hema huko Yerusalemu.
sw.B: Lakini Daudi alikuwa amelipandisha sanduku la Mungu kutoka Kiriath-yearimu mpaka mahali alipokuwa amelitayarishia, kwa sababu alikuwa amelipigia hema huko Yerusalemu.
sw.R: Lakini Daudi alikuwa amekwisha kulileta sanduku la Mungu, yaani, sanduku takatifu la agano, kutoka mji wa Kiriath-yearimu. Alikuwa amelisimamishia hema huko Yerusalemu, mahali alipokuwa amelitayarishia.

vi.L: Nhưng hòm của Đức Chúa Trời thì Đa-vít đã đem lên từ Ki-ri-át Giê-a-rim đến [nơi] Đa-vít đã chuẩn bị cho nó, vì vua đã dựng cho nó một cái lều tại Giê-ru-sa-lem.
vi.B: Nhưng Đa-vít đã rước hòm của Đức Chúa Trời từ Ki-ri-át Giê-a-rim lên nơi vua đã chuẩn bị, vì vua đã dựng một cái lều cho hòm tại Giê-ru-sa-lem.
vi.R: Nhưng trước đó Đa-vít đã rước hòm của Đức Chúa Trời, tức cái hòm thánh của giao ước, từ thành Ki-ri-át Giê-a-rim lên. Vua đã dựng một cái lều cho hòm ở Giê-ru-sa-lem, tại nơi vua đã chuẩn bị sẵn.

ko.L: 그러나 하나님의 궤는 다윗이 기럇여아림에서 다윗이 그것을 위해 준비한 [곳으로] 올려 왔다. 그가 예루살렘에 그것을 위해 장막을 쳤기 때문이다.
ko.B: 그러나 다윗은 하나님의 궤를 기럇여아림에서 자기가 마련한 곳으로 이미 옮겨 왔다. 그가 예루살렘에 그 궤를 위해 장막을 쳐 두었기 때문이다.
ko.R: 그러나 다윗은 이미 하나님의 궤, 곧 언약을 담은 거룩한 상자를 기럇여아림 성읍에서 옮겨 왔다. 그는 예루살렘에 미리 마련한 곳에 그 궤를 위해 장막을 쳐 두었다.

pt.L: Mas a arca de Deus Davi tinha feito subir de Quiriate-Jearim ao [lugar que] Davi lhe tinha preparado, porque ele tinha armado para ela uma tenda em Jerusalém.
pt.B: Mas Davi tinha levado a arca de Deus de Quiriate-Jearim para o lugar que ele tinha preparado, pois tinha armado uma tenda para ela em Jerusalém.
pt.R: Mas Davi já tinha levado a arca de Deus, a caixa sagrada da aliança, da cidade de Quiriate-Jearim para Jerusalém. Ele tinha armado uma tenda para ela ali, num lugar que tinha preparado para ela.

decisions.choice: the ark brought to Jerusalem: 1 Chronicles 13-16
decisions.reason: David first tried to bring the ark from Kiriath-jearim (1 Chronicles 13:5-6), and then brought it to Jerusalem and put it in the tent he had pitched for it (1 Chronicles 15:1; 16:1; 2 Samuel 6:17).

decisions.choice: but the ark: two places of worship
decisions.reason: In Solomon's day the ark and the tent of meeting were in different places: the ark in a tent in Jerusalem, the old tent and its bronze altar at Gibeon. The verse explains why Solomon sacrificed at Gibeon, where the altar was, though the ark was in Jerusalem. The temple would bring them together (5:2-5).

decisions.choice: to [the place] David had prepared: a short relative clause
decisions.reason: The Hebrew joins the preposition straight to the verb, "to he-prepared-for-it". It means "to the place David had prepared for it", as 1 Chronicles 15:1, 3 say.

decisions.choice: the ark of God, the sacred chest
decisions.reason: Readable explains the ark once: it was the sacred chest of the covenant.

decisions.choice: "el arca de Dios, el cofre sagrado"
decisions.reason: As the English Readable, a short phrase says what the ark was.

decisions.choice: "하나님의 궤, 곧 언약을 담은 거룩한 상자"
decisions.reason: Readable explains the ark once, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: a arca de Deus, a caixa sagrada da aliança (R); Quiriate-Jearim
decisions.reason: Readable explains the ark once, as the English does, in the words 1 Kings 3:15 uses in Portuguese ("a caixa que guardava a aliança"); "Quiriate-Jearim" as 1 Chronicles 13:5-6 in Portuguese (m1).

source.text: וּמִזְבַּ֣ח הַנְּחֹ֗שֶׁת אֲשֶׁ֤ר עָשָׂה֙ בְּצַלְאֵל֙ בֶּן־אוּרִ֣י בֶן־ח֔וּר שָׂ֕ם לִפְנֵ֖י מִשְׁכַּ֣ן יְהוָ֑ה וַיִּדְרְשֵׁ֥הוּ שְׁלֹמֹ֖ה וְהַקָּהָֽל׃

records.literal_gloss: And [the] altar of the bronze which had made Bezalel son of Uri son of Hur he had put before [the] tabernacle of Yahweh; and sought him Solomon and the assembly.

en.L: And the altar of bronze that Bezalel son of Uri, son of Hur, had made, he had put before the tabernacle of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}; and Solomon and the assembly sought {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.
en.B: Bezalel son of Uri, son of Hur, had made the bronze altar and set it in front of the tabernacle of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, and there Solomon and the assembly sought {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.
en.R: Bezalel, the son of Uri and grandson of Hur, had made the bronze altar and set it in front of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}'s tabernacle. There Solomon and the people came to seek {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.

es.L: Y el altar de bronce que había hecho Bezalel hijo de Uri, hijo de Hur, lo había puesto delante del tabernáculo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}; y lo buscaron Salomón y la asamblea.
es.B: Bezalel hijo de Uri, hijo de Hur, había hecho el altar de bronce y lo había puesto delante del tabernáculo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, y allí Salomón y la asamblea lo buscaron.
es.R: Bezalel, hijo de Uri y nieto de Hur, había hecho el altar de bronce y lo había puesto delante del tabernáculo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}. Allí fueron Salomón y el pueblo a buscar {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}.

fr.L: Et l’autel de bronze qu’avait fait Betsaleel fils d’Ouri, fils de Hour, il l’avait placé devant la Demeure {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} ; et Salomon et l’assemblée {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} recherchèrent.
fr.B: Betsaleel, fils d’Ouri, fils de Hour, avait fait l’autel de bronze et l’avait placé devant la Demeure {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} ; et c’est là que Salomon et l’assemblée {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} recherchèrent.
fr.R: Betsaleel, fils d’Ouri et petit-fils de Hour, avait fabriqué l’autel de bronze et l’avait placé devant la Demeure {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}. C’est là que Salomon et le peuple sont venus chercher {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.

sw.L: Na madhabahu ya shaba aliyoifanya Bezaleli mwana wa Uri, mwana wa Huri, aliiweka mbele ya maskani ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}; na Sulemani na kusanyiko wakamtafuta.
sw.B: Bezaleli mwana wa Uri, mwana wa Huri, alikuwa ameitengeneza madhabahu ya shaba na kuiweka mbele ya maskani ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}; na huko Sulemani na kusanyiko walimtafuta.
sw.R: Bezaleli, mwana wa Uri na mjukuu wa Huri, alikuwa ameitengeneza madhabahu ya shaba na kuiweka mbele ya maskani ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Huko Sulemani na watu walikuja kumtafuta {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.

vi.L: Còn bàn thờ bằng đồng mà Bết-sa-lê-ên con trai U-ri, con trai Hu-rơ, đã làm, thì người đã đặt trước đền tạm của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}; và Sa-lô-môn cùng hội chúng tìm cầu {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Bết-sa-lê-ên con trai U-ri, cháu Hu-rơ, đã làm bàn thờ bằng đồng và đặt nó trước đền tạm của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}; tại đó Sa-lô-môn và hội chúng tìm cầu {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Bết-sa-lê-ên, con trai U-ri và cháu Hu-rơ, đã làm bàn thờ bằng đồng và đặt trước đền tạm của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}. Tại đó Sa-lô-môn và dân chúng đến để tìm cầu {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.

ko.L: 그리고 훌의 손자 우리의 아들 브살렐이 만든 놋 제단을 그가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 성막 앞에 두었다. 그리고 솔로몬과 회중이 그분을 찾았다.
ko.B: 훌의 손자이며 우리의 아들인 브살렐이 놋 제단을 만들어 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 성막 앞에 두었는데, 솔로몬과 회중이 거기서 주님을 찾았다.
ko.R: 훌의 손자이며 우리의 아들인 브살렐이 놋 제단을 만들어 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 성막 앞에 두었다. 솔로몬과 백성은 거기에 가서 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 찾았다.

pt.L: E o altar de bronze que Bezalel, filho de Uri, filho de Hur, tinha feito, ele [o] tinha posto diante do tabernáculo {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}; e Salomão e a assembleia {{deity_pronoun:o|O}} buscaram.
pt.B: Bezalel, filho de Uri, filho de Hur, tinha feito o altar de bronze e o tinha colocado diante do tabernáculo {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, e ali Salomão e a assembleia {{deity_pronoun:o|O}} buscaram.
pt.R: Bezalel, filho de Uri e neto de Hur, tinha feito o altar de bronze e o tinha colocado na frente do tabernáculo {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}. Ali Salomão e o povo foram buscar {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}.

decisions.choice: he had put
decisions.reason: The traditional Hebrew text reads a word meaning "he had put": Bezalel set the altar before the tabernacle. Some Hebrew manuscripts and the ancient Greek and Latin translations read a word that differs by one dot and means "there": "the bronze altar ... was there before the tabernacle". Either way the altar stood at Gibeon.

decisions.choice: the bronze altar of Bezalel: the altar of the wilderness
decisions.reason: Bezalel son of Uri, son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah, was the craftsman Yahweh chose to make the tabernacle and its furnishings (Exodus 31:2-5), and he made the bronze altar for burnt offerings (Exodus 38:1-2). 1 Kings 3:4 says only "that altar"; Chronicles names it, to show that Solomon worshiped at the altar Yahweh had commanded.

decisions.choice: sought him: sought Yahweh
decisions.reason: The word "him" can point back to Yahweh, named just before, or to the altar: "sought it out", that is, went to it. Seeking Yahweh, turning to him in worship and asking his help, is a favorite theme of Chronicles (1 Chronicles 16:11; 22:19; 2 Chronicles 7:14), and verses 6-7 show Solomon worshiping and God answering. Those who read "it" take the clause as Solomon and the assembly going to the altar.

decisions.choice: the tabernacle of Yahweh: the tent of meeting
decisions.reason: The tabernacle and the tent of meeting (verse 3) are the same tent (Exodus 40:2). The bronze altar stood in its courtyard, before its entrance (Exodus 40:6).

decisions.choice: Bezalel ... had made the bronze altar and set it
decisions.reason: The Hebrew puts the altar first for emphasis. Balanced and Readable make Bezalel the subject so that "he had put" reads naturally.

decisions.choice: there ... sought him (Balanced); came to seek the LORD (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable add "there", which the context implies. Readable names the LORD for "him" so that it is not read as Bezalel (m3).

decisions.choice: "lo buscaron"
decisions.reason: The Hebrew "him" points back to Yahweh (meaning decision); Spanish "lo" keeps it as open as the English "him", with no deity_pronoun span, since a clitic joined to the verb takes none in the Spanish drafts.

decisions.choice: "Betsaleel fils d'Ouri, fils de Hour"; "la Demeure" for the tabernacle
decisions.reason: The forms of the French Pentateuch (Exodus 31:2; 40:2), where the tabernacle is "la Demeure" and its tent "la tente de la Rencontre".

decisions.choice: wakamtafuta (Literal); walimtafuta (Balanced)
decisions.reason: The object marker "-m-" is the one for a person, so "wakamtafuta" reads as seeking the LORD, as the English takes "him" (m3); "-i-" would point to the altar.

decisions.choice: "đền tạm" for the tabernacle; "tìm cầu" for seeking God
decisions.reason: "Đền tạm" is the word the published Exodus uses for this tent. "Tìm cầu" says seeking God in worship and prayer (m3), Chronicles' recurring phrase; plain "tìm kiếm" would sound like looking for something lost.

decisions.choice: "그분을" (L), "주님을" (B), "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}를" (R) for "him"
decisions.reason: The pronoun points to the LORD (m3). Korean uses no deity_pronoun span; Balanced names him with "주님" so the reader does not take it as Bezalel or the altar, and Readable names him as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: buscar (every level); o (deity_pronoun)
decisions.reason: "Buscar" keeps the Chronicler's key word for seeking God (m3), as 1 Chronicles 13:3 sets it in Portuguese for the whole book. The object pronoun "o" refers to God and takes the deity_pronoun span where the English has "him"; Readable names the LORD, as the English does.

source.text: וַיַּעַל֩ שְׁלֹמֹ֨ה שָׁ֜ם עַל־מִזְבַּ֤ח הַנְּחֹ֨שֶׁת֙ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֖ר לְאֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד וַיַּ֧עַל עָלָ֛יו עֹל֖וֹת אָֽלֶף׃

records.literal_gloss: And went up Solomon there to [the] altar of the bronze before Yahweh, which [was] at [the] tent of meeting, and offered up on it burnt offerings a thousand.

en.L: And Solomon went up there to the bronze altar before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, which [was] at the tent of meeting, and he offered up on it a thousand burnt offerings.
en.B: There Solomon went up to the bronze altar before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} at the tent of meeting, and he offered up a thousand burnt offerings on it.
en.R: Solomon went up to the bronze altar at the meeting tent, where he stood before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. He offered a thousand burnt offerings on the altar there.

es.L: Y subió Salomón allí al altar de bronce delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, que [estaba] en la Tienda del Encuentro, y ofreció sobre él mil holocaustos.
es.B: Allí Salomón subió al altar de bronce que estaba delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, en la Tienda del Encuentro, y ofreció sobre él mil holocaustos.
es.R: Salomón subió al altar de bronce de la Tienda del Encuentro, donde estaba delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}. Ofreció allí mil holocaustos sobre el altar.

fr.L: Et Salomon monta là, à l’autel de bronze devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, qui [était] à la tente de la Rencontre, et il offrit sur lui mille holocaustes.
fr.B: Là, Salomon monta à l’autel de bronze, devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, près de la tente de la Rencontre, et il y offrit mille holocaustes.
fr.R: Salomon est monté à l’autel de bronze, près de la tente de la Rencontre, où il s’est tenu devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. Il a offert mille holocaustes sur cet autel.

sw.L: Sulemani akapanda huko kwenye madhabahu ya shaba mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, iliyokuwa [penye] Hema la Kukutania, akatoa juu yake sadaka 1,000 za kuteketezwa.
sw.B: Huko Sulemani alipanda kwenye madhabahu ya shaba mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} penye Hema la Kukutania, akatoa juu yake sadaka 1,000 za kuteketezwa.
sw.R: Sulemani alipanda kwenye madhabahu ya shaba penye Hema la Kukutania, akasimama mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Akatoa sadaka 1,000 za kuteketezwa juu ya madhabahu hiyo.

vi.L: Sa-lô-môn đi lên đó, đến bàn thờ bằng đồng trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, [bàn thờ] ở tại Lều Hội Kiến, và dâng trên đó một ngàn của lễ thiêu.
vi.B: Tại đó Sa-lô-môn đi lên bàn thờ bằng đồng trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} nơi Lều Hội Kiến, và dâng một ngàn của lễ thiêu trên bàn thờ ấy.
vi.R: Sa-lô-môn đi lên bàn thờ bằng đồng tại Lều Hội Kiến, nơi vua đứng trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} để thờ phượng. Vua dâng một ngàn của lễ thiêu trên bàn thờ tại đó.

ko.L: 그리고 솔로몬이 거기서 회막에 [있는] {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 앞의 놋 제단으로 올라가서, 그 위에 번제물 천 마리를 바쳤다.
ko.B: 솔로몬은 거기 회막 곁, {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 앞에 있는 놋 제단으로 올라가서 그 위에 번제물 천 마리를 바쳤다.
ko.R: 솔로몬은 회막 곁에 있는 놋 제단으로 올라가서 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 앞에 섰다. 그리고 그 제단에서 번제물 천 마리를 바쳤다.

pt.L: E Salomão subiu ali ao altar de bronze diante {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, que [estava] junto à tenda do encontro, e ofereceu sobre ele mil holocaustos.
pt.B: Ali Salomão subiu ao altar de bronze diante {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, junto à tenda do encontro, e ofereceu sobre ele mil holocaustos.
pt.R: Salomão subiu ao altar de bronze que ficava junto à tenda do encontro, e ali ele esteve na presença {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}. Ele ofereceu mil holocaustos sobre aquele altar.

decisions.choice: a thousand burnt offerings, as in 1 Kings 3:4
decisions.reason: 1 Kings 3:4 says that Solomon offered a thousand burnt offerings "on that altar". Chronicles says which altar it was: the bronze altar at the tent of meeting (verse 5).

decisions.choice: which was at the tent of meeting: the altar belonged to the tent
decisions.reason: The words "which [was] at the tent of meeting" describe the altar: it was the altar of the tent, standing before it. "Before Yahweh" says that worship there was done in his presence.

decisions.choice: went up; a thousand burnt offerings
decisions.reason: One went up to an altar, which stood raised above the ground. A burnt offering was burned whole; a thousand of them show a king's generous devotion, and would have been burned over several days (compare 1 Kings 3:4).

decisions.choice: where he stood before the LORD
decisions.reason: Readable says plainly what "before the LORD" means here: Solomon worshiped in his presence.

decisions.choice: sadaka 1,000 (figures)
decisions.reason: Numbers above ninety-nine are written in figures in this block, as in the Swahili 1 Kings 12-22, 2 Kings and the Pentateuch; 1 Kings 1-11 writes them in words, an unevenness left for a reviewer.

decisions.choice: mil holocaustos
decisions.reason: As 1 Kings 3:4 in Portuguese (m1): "holocausto" is the Old Testament term for the burnt offering, and the round number is written in words.

source.text: בַּלַּ֣יְלָה הַה֔וּא נִרְאָ֥ה אֱלֹהִ֖ים לִשְׁלֹמֹ֑ה וַיֹּ֣אמֶר ל֔וֹ שְׁאַ֖ל מָ֥ה אֶתֶּן־לָֽךְ׃

records.literal_gloss: In the night, that [one], appeared God to Solomon and said to him, Ask what I shall give to you.

en.L: In that night God appeared to Solomon and said to him, "Ask what I shall give you."
en.B: That night God appeared to Solomon and said to him, "Ask for whatever you want {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} to give you."
en.R: That night God appeared to Solomon and said to him, "Ask {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} for anything you want, and I will give it to you."

es.L: En aquella noche se apareció Dios a Salomón y le dijo: «Pide lo que quieras que yo te dé».
es.B: Aquella noche Dios se le apareció a Salomón y le dijo: «Pídeme lo que quieras que te dé».
es.R: Aquella noche Dios se le apareció a Salomón y le dijo: «Pídeme lo que quieras, y yo te lo daré».

fr.L: Cette nuit-là, Dieu apparut à Salomon et lui dit : « Demande ce que je dois te donner. »
fr.B: Cette nuit-là, Dieu apparut à Salomon et lui dit : « Demande ce que tu veux que je te donne. »
fr.R: Cette nuit-là, Dieu est apparu à Salomon et lui a dit : « Demande-{{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} tout ce que tu veux, et je te le donnerai. »

sw.L: Usiku ule Mungu akamtokea Sulemani, akamwambia, "Omba nikupe nini."
sw.B: Usiku ule Mungu alimtokea Sulemani, akamwambia, "Omba lolote unalotaka nikupe."
sw.R: Usiku ule Mungu alimtokea Sulemani, akamwambia, "Niombe chochote unachotaka, nami nitakupa."

vi.L: Trong đêm ấy, Đức Chúa Trời hiện ra với Sa-lô-môn và phán với vua: "Hãy xin điều {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ ban cho ngươi."
vi.B: Đêm ấy Đức Chúa Trời hiện ra với Sa-lô-môn và phán với vua: "Con muốn {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} ban cho con điều gì, hãy xin đi."
vi.R: Đêm ấy Đức Chúa Trời hiện ra với Sa-lô-môn và phán: "Con muốn gì, hãy xin {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ ban cho con."

ko.L: 그 밤에 하나님께서 솔로몬에게 나타나셔서 그에게 말씀하셨다. "내가 네게 무엇을 줄지 구하여라."
ko.B: 그날 밤 하나님께서 솔로몬에게 나타나셔서 말씀하셨다. "내가 네게 무엇을 주면 좋겠느냐? 구하여라."
ko.R: 그날 밤 하나님께서 솔로몬에게 나타나셔서 말씀하셨다. "무엇이든 원하는 것을 구하여라. 내가 너에게 주겠다."

pt.L: Naquela noite Deus apareceu a Salomão e lhe disse: "Pede o que queres que eu te dê."
pt.B: Naquela noite Deus apareceu a Salomão e lhe disse: "Pede-{{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} o que queres que eu te dê."
pt.R: Naquela noite Deus apareceu a Salomão e disse a ele: "Pede-{{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} o que quiseres, e eu te darei."

decisions.choice: God appeared that night: 1 Kings 3:5 without the dream
decisions.reason: 1 Kings 3:5 says that Yahweh appeared to Solomon at Gibeon "in a dream of the night", and 3:15 says that he woke and knew it had been a dream. Chronicles says "God" appeared "in that night" and does not mention a dream. God's words are the same in both.

decisions.choice: Ask what I shall give you: an open offer
decisions.reason: God does not limit what Solomon may ask. The offer shows what Solomon most wants, and his answer pleases God (verse 11; 1 Kings 3:10).

decisions.choice: Ask {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} for anything you want, and I will give it to you.
decisions.reason: As in 1 Kings 3:5: Readable spells out the offer as a promise, which is what the question means here.

decisions.choice: God's offer worded as 1 Kings 3:5
decisions.reason: The Hebrew of the offer is the same as 1 Kings 3:5, so the Spanish Kings wording is kept at each level ("Pídeme" without a span, a clitic).

decisions.choice: God speaks 해라체 with "나" and "너"; no deity_pronoun span in Korean
decisions.reason: As in 1 Kings 3:5, whose words this verse repeats; Korean has no capitalized pronoun to switch.

decisions.choice: God says "Ta" and calls Solomon "ngươi" (L), "con" (B, R); Solomon says "con" and "Ngài"
decisions.reason: The rule for God's words in Chronicles: God speaking to one person who serves him (David, Solomon, Elijah, a prophet) says "ngươi" at Literal and "con" at Balanced and Readable, as in Genesis and the Pentateuch; his words to a king he is judging, to Israel as a nation or to the nations stay "ngươi" / "các ngươi". The address forms of the same scene in 1 Kings 3:5-14 are kept here.

decisions.choice: tu (God to Solomon and Solomon to God); Pede o que queres que eu te dê (L, B); Pede-me o que quiseres, e eu te darei (R)
decisions.reason: God's words are those of 1 Kings 3:5 (m1), and so is the Portuguese at every level: God speaks to Solomon with "tu", and Solomon answers him with "tu" in verses 8-10, every pronoun for God under the deity_pronoun setting.

source.text: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר שְׁלֹמֹה֙ לֵֽאלֹהִ֔ים אַתָּ֗ה עָשִׂ֛יתָ עִם־דָּוִ֥יד אָבִ֖י חֶ֣סֶד גָּד֑וֹל וְהִמְלַכְתַּ֖נִי תַּחְתָּֽיו׃

records.literal_gloss: And said Solomon to God, You have done with David my father steadfast love great, and made me king in his place.

en.L: And Solomon said to God, "You have shown great steadfast love to David my father, and have made me king in his place.
en.B: Solomon said to God, "You showed great faithful love to my father David, and {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have put me on the throne in his place.
en.R: Solomon answered God, "You showed great faithful love to my father David. And {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have made me the king who takes his place.

es.L: Y dijo Salomón a Dios: «Tú has hecho con David mi padre gran amor leal, y me has hecho rey en su lugar.
es.B: Salomón le dijo a Dios: «Tú mostraste gran amor fiel a mi padre David, y {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} me has puesto en el trono en su lugar.
es.R: Salomón le respondió a Dios: «Tú mostraste gran amor fiel a mi padre David. Y {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} me has hecho rey en su lugar.

fr.L: Et Salomon dit à Dieu : « Tu as montré un grand amour loyal à David mon père, et {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} m’as fait régner à sa place.
fr.B: Salomon dit à Dieu : « Tu as montré un grand amour fidèle à mon père David, et {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} m’as placé sur le trône à sa place.
fr.R: Salomon a répondu à Dieu : « Tu as montré un grand amour fidèle à mon père David. Et {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as fait de moi le roi qui le remplace.

sw.L: Sulemani akamwambia Mungu, "Wewe umemtendea Daudi baba yangu upendo usiokoma mkuu, ukanitawaza mahali pake.
sw.B: Sulemani akamwambia Mungu, "Ulimwonyesha baba yangu Daudi upendo usiokoma mkuu, {{deity_pronoun:nawe|Nawe}} umeniweka kwenye kiti cha enzi mahali pake.
sw.R: Sulemani akamjibu Mungu, "Ulimwonyesha baba yangu Daudi upendo usiokoma mkuu. Nawe umenifanya kuwa mfalme wa kushika nafasi yake.

vi.L: Sa-lô-môn thưa với Đức Chúa Trời: "Ngài đã tỏ tình yêu thương thành tín lớn lao với Đa-vít cha con, và đã lập con làm vua thay cho người.
vi.B: Sa-lô-môn thưa với Đức Chúa Trời: "Ngài đã tỏ tình yêu thương thành tín lớn lao với Đa-vít cha con, và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã lập con lên ngôi thay cho người.
vi.R: Sa-lô-môn thưa với Đức Chúa Trời: "Ngài đã rất nhân từ và thành tín với Đa-vít cha con. Và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã lập con làm vua kế vị người.

ko.L: 그리고 솔로몬이 하나님께 말씀드렸다. "주님께서는 제 아버지 다윗에게 큰 한결같은 사랑을 베푸셨고, 그를 대신하여 저를 왕으로 삼으셨습니다.
ko.B: 솔로몬이 하나님께 대답했다. "주님께서는 제 아버지 다윗에게 크나큰 한결같은 사랑을 베푸셨고, 저를 그의 뒤를 이어 왕으로 세우셨습니다.
ko.R: 솔로몬이 하나님께 대답했다. "주님께서는 제 아버지 다윗에게 참으로 큰 변함없는 사랑을 베푸셨습니다. 그리고 저를 그의 뒤를 이을 왕으로 세우셨습니다.

pt.L: E Salomão disse a Deus: "Tu mostraste grande amor leal a Davi, meu pai, e me fizeste rei no lugar dele.
pt.B: Salomão disse a Deus: "Tu mostraste grande amor leal ao meu pai Davi, e {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} me puseste no trono no lugar dele.
pt.R: Salomão respondeu a Deus: "Tu mostraste grande amor leal ao meu pai Davi. E {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} me fizeste rei para ocupar o lugar dele.

decisions.choice: great steadfast love: loyal kindness that keeps faith
decisions.reason: The word names love that is loyal to a bond and keeps its promises. Yahweh had promised David a son on his throne and a love that would not be taken away from him (1 Chronicles 17:11-13). Solomon sees that promise kept in himself.

decisions.choice: Solomon's prayer, shorter than in 1 Kings 3:6-7
decisions.reason: 1 Kings 3:6 has the same opening words, but there Solomon also calls David Yahweh's servant and speaks of how David walked before him in faithfulness and righteousness. Chronicles gives only the love shown to David and joins to it "you have made me king in his place" (compare 1 Kings 3:7). It also leaves out Solomon's words about being a little boy.

decisions.choice: steadfast love (Literal); faithful love (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: The wording kept for this word in these books, as in 1 Kings 3:6.

decisions.choice: "amor leal" (L); "amor fiel" (B, R)
decisions.reason: *Ḥesed* follows the Psalms and Samuel notes, as in 1 Kings 3:6, whose opening words Chronicles repeats.

decisions.choice: "tình yêu thương thành tín" (L, B); "rất nhân từ và thành tín" (R)
decisions.reason: The wording of the same words in 1 Kings 3:6, kept for *ḥesed* in this prayer (m1).

decisions.choice: Solomon prays in 합쇼체 with "주님" and "저"; "한결같은 사랑" (L, B), "변함없는 사랑" (R) for *ḥesed*
decisions.reason: As in 1 Kings 3:6, whose opening words this verse repeats.

decisions.choice: grande amor leal (every level)
decisions.reason: As 1 Kings 3:6 in Portuguese: God's steadfast love (m1) is "amor leal" at every level, where the English says "faithful love" at Balanced and Readable; it is the wording the refrain of 5:13 keeps too.

source.text: עַתָּה֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהִ֔ים יֵֽאָמֵן֙ דְּבָ֣רְךָ֔ עִ֖ם דָּוִ֣יד אָבִ֑י כִּ֤י אַתָּה֙ הִמְלַכְתַּ֔נִי עַל־עַ֕ם רַ֖ב כַּעֲפַ֥ר הָאָֽרֶץ׃

records.literal_gloss: Now, Yahweh God, let be confirmed your word with David my father, for you have made me king over a people numerous like the dust of the earth.

en.L: Now, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}} God, let {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} word to David my father be confirmed, for {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have made me king over a people as many as the dust of the earth.
en.B: Now, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}} God, let {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} promise to my father David prove true, since {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have made me king over a people as many as the dust of the earth.
en.R: Now, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}} God, please keep the promise {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} made to my father David. You have made me king over a people as countless as the dust of the earth.

es.L: Ahora, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}} Dios, que se confirme {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} palabra a David mi padre, porque {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} me has hecho rey sobre un pueblo numeroso como el polvo de la tierra.
es.B: Ahora, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}} Dios, que se cumpla {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} promesa a mi padre David, ya que {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} me has hecho rey sobre un pueblo tan numeroso como el polvo de la tierra.
es.R: Ahora, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}} Dios, te ruego que cumplas la promesa que {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} le hiciste a mi padre David. Tú me has hecho rey sobre un pueblo tan numeroso como el polvo de la tierra.

fr.L: Maintenant, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} Dieu, que {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} parole à David mon père soit confirmée, car {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} m’as fait régner sur un peuple nombreux comme la poussière de la terre.
fr.B: Maintenant, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} Dieu, que {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} promesse à mon père David s’accomplisse, puisque {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} m’as fait roi d’un peuple aussi nombreux que la poussière de la terre.
fr.R: Maintenant, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} Dieu, tiens la promesse que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as faite à mon père David. Tu m’as fait roi d’un peuple aussi nombreux que la poussière de la terre.

sw.L: Sasa, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu, neno {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}} kwa Daudi baba yangu na lithibitishwe, kwa maana {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} umenitawaza juu ya watu wengi kama mavumbi ya nchi.
sw.B: Sasa, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu, ahadi {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} kwa baba yangu Daudi na itimie, kwa kuwa umenifanya mfalme juu ya watu wengi kama mavumbi ya nchi.
sw.R: Sasa, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu, tafadhali timiza ahadi uliyompa baba yangu Daudi. Umenifanya mfalme juu ya watu wasiohesabika, wengi kama mavumbi ya nchi.

vi.L: Bây giờ, lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời, nguyện lời {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} [phán] với Đa-vít cha con được vững lập, vì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã lập con làm vua trên một dân đông như bụi đất.
vi.B: Bây giờ, lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời, xin cho lời hứa của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} với Đa-vít cha con được thành tựu, vì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã lập con làm vua trên một dân đông như bụi đất.
vi.R: Bây giờ, lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời, xin {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} giữ lời {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã hứa với Đa-vít cha con. Ngài đã lập con làm vua trên một dân đông vô số như bụi trên mặt đất.

ko.L: 이제 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 하나님, 제 아버지 다윗에게 하신 주님의 말씀이 굳게 서게 해 주십시오. 주님께서 땅의 먼지처럼 많은 백성 위에 저를 왕으로 삼으셨기 때문입니다.
ko.B: 이제 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 하나님, 제 아버지 다윗에게 하신 주님의 약속이 이루어지게 해 주십시오. 주님께서 저를 땅의 먼지처럼 많은 백성의 왕으로 세우셨기 때문입니다.
ko.R: 이제 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 하나님, 제 아버지 다윗에게 하신 약속을 지켜 주십시오. 주님께서 저를 땅의 먼지처럼 셀 수 없이 많은 백성의 왕으로 세우셨습니다.

pt.L: Agora, {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}} Deus, seja confirmada a {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} palavra a Davi, meu pai, porque {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} me fizeste rei sobre um povo numeroso como o pó da terra.
pt.B: Agora, {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}} Deus, que se cumpra a {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} promessa ao meu pai Davi, pois {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} me fizeste rei sobre um povo tão numeroso como o pó da terra.
pt.R: Agora, {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}} Deus, por favor, cumpre a promessa que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} fizeste ao meu pai Davi. Tu me fizeste rei sobre um povo que não se pode contar, como o pó da terra.

decisions.choice: let your word be confirmed: let your promise prove true
decisions.reason: The verb means to be made firm, shown to be true. "Your word" is Yahweh's promise to David that his son would reign and build the house (1 Chronicles 17:11-14). David prayed in the same words that the promise be confirmed (1 Chronicles 17:23-24); Solomon asks that it go on coming true in him.

decisions.choice: a people as many as the dust of the earth: the promise to Abraham
decisions.reason: Yahweh promised Abraham and Jacob descendants as many as the dust of the earth (Genesis 13:16; 28:14). 1 Kings 3:8 says instead "a great people, who cannot be numbered"; Chronicles uses the words of the promise itself.

decisions.choice: promise (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "word"; Balanced and Readable say "promise", which is what the word was (m1).

decisions.choice: please keep the promise
decisions.reason: Readable turns the wish "let it be confirmed" into a request to God, which is what it is.

decisions.choice: deity_pronoun spans on "tú", "tu"
decisions.reason: Solomon's words to God carry the deity_pronoun span on every written pronoun and possessive for God, as the Spanish Kings does; clitics ("te ruego") and sentence-initial "Tú" are written plain.

decisions.choice: "lời hứa" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "lời" (word); Balanced and Readable say "lời hứa", which is what the word was (m1), as the English does.

decisions.choice: "말씀" (L), "약속" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The word God spoke to David is his promise (m1), as the English Balanced and Readable say.

decisions.choice: SENHOR (vocative, no article)
decisions.reason: In the vocative the name has no article, "SENHOR Deus", as in Solomon's prayer in 1 Kings 3:7 in Portuguese.

source.text: עַתָּ֗ה חָכְמָ֤ה וּמַדָּע֙ תֶּן־לִ֔י וְאֵֽצְאָ֛ה לִפְנֵ֥י הָֽעָם־הַזֶּ֖ה וְאָב֑וֹאָה כִּֽי־מִ֣י יִשְׁפֹּ֔ט אֶת־עַמְּךָ֥ הַזֶּ֖ה הַגָּדֽוֹל׃ס

records.literal_gloss: Now wisdom and knowledge give to me, and I will go out before this people and I will come in; for who will judge your people, this great [one]?

en.L: Now give me wisdom and knowledge, that I may go out before this people and come in; for who can judge this great people of {{deity_pronoun:yours|Yours}}?"
en.B: Now give me wisdom and knowledge, so that I may go out and come in before this people as their leader. For who can judge this great people of {{deity_pronoun:yours|Yours}}?"
en.R: Give me wisdom and knowledge so that I can lead this people. Who could ever judge this great people of {{deity_pronoun:yours|Yours}}?"

es.L: Ahora, dame sabiduría y conocimiento, para que salga y entre delante de este pueblo; porque ¿quién juzgará a este gran pueblo {{deity_pronoun:tuyo|Tuyo}}?».
es.B: Ahora dame sabiduría y conocimiento, para que yo salga y entre delante de este pueblo como su jefe. Porque ¿quién es capaz de juzgar a este gran pueblo {{deity_pronoun:tuyo|Tuyo}}?».
es.R: Dame sabiduría y conocimiento para que pueda guiar a este pueblo. ¿Quién podría juzgar a este gran pueblo {{deity_pronoun:tuyo|Tuyo}}?».

fr.L: Maintenant, donne-moi sagesse et connaissance, pour que je sorte devant ce peuple et que j’entre ; car qui jugera {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} peuple, ce [peuple] si grand ? »
fr.B: Maintenant, donne-moi la sagesse et la connaissance, afin que je sache sortir et entrer devant ce peuple pour le conduire. Car qui pourrait juger un peuple aussi grand que le {{deity_pronoun:tien|Tien}} ? »
fr.R: Donne-moi la sagesse et la connaissance, pour que je puisse diriger ce peuple. Qui pourrait juger un peuple aussi grand que le {{deity_pronoun:tien|Tien}} ? »

sw.L: Sasa nipe hekima na maarifa, nipate kutoka na kuingia mbele ya watu hawa; kwa maana ni nani awezaye kuwahukumu watu {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} hawa walio wengi?"
sw.B: Sasa nipe hekima na maarifa, ili nipate kutoka na kuingia mbele ya watu hawa kama kiongozi wao. Kwa maana ni nani awezaye kuwahukumu watu {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} walio wengi namna hii?"
sw.R: Nipe hekima na maarifa ili niweze kuwaongoza watu hawa. Ni nani angeweza kuwahukumu watu {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} walio wengi hivi?"

vi.L: Bây giờ xin ban cho con sự khôn ngoan và sự hiểu biết, để con đi ra đi vào trước dân này; vì ai có thể xét xử dân lớn này của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}?"
vi.B: Bây giờ xin ban cho con sự khôn ngoan và hiểu biết, để con đi ra đi vào trước dân này mà lãnh đạo họ. Vì ai có thể xét xử dân đông đảo này của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}?"
vi.R: Xin ban cho con sự khôn ngoan và hiểu biết để con biết lãnh đạo dân này. Ai có thể xét xử một dân đông như dân của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}?"

ko.L: 이제 제게 지혜와 지식을 주셔서, 제가 이 백성 앞에서 나가고 들어오게 해 주십시오. 누가 주님의 이 큰 백성을 재판할 수 있겠습니까?"
ko.B: 이제 제게 지혜와 지식을 주셔서, 이 백성 앞에서 나가고 들어오며 그들을 이끌 수 있게 해 주십시오. 누가 이렇게 많은 주님의 백성을 재판할 수 있겠습니까?"
ko.R: 저에게 지혜와 지식을 주셔서 이 백성을 이끌 수 있게 해 주십시오. 누가 이렇게 많은 주님의 백성을 다스릴 수 있겠습니까?"

pt.L: Agora dá-me sabedoria e conhecimento, para que eu saia diante deste povo e entre; pois quem julgará este {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} povo tão grande?"
pt.B: Agora dá-me sabedoria e conhecimento, para que eu possa sair e entrar à frente deste povo como o seu líder. Pois quem é capaz de julgar este grande povo, que é {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}}?"
pt.R: Dá-me sabedoria e conhecimento para que eu saiba liderar este povo. Quem conseguiria julgar este povo tão grande, que é {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}}?"

decisions.choice: wisdom and knowledge: Solomon's request in other words than 1 Kings 3:9
decisions.reason: In 1 Kings 3:9 Solomon asks for "a listening heart to judge your people, to discern between good and evil". Here he asks for "wisdom and knowledge", and the phrase "to go out and come in", which in Kings belongs to his confession that he does not know how (1 Kings 3:7), becomes the purpose of his request. The closing question is much the same, but Kings calls the people "heavy" and Chronicles "great".

decisions.choice: knowledge: understanding, insight
decisions.reason: The word is a rare one, found also in Daniel 1:4, 17 and Ecclesiastes 10:20. It means knowledge or understanding, the ability to grasp what is going on and see what should be done. With "wisdom" it names the skill a ruler needs.

decisions.choice: go out and come in before this people: lead them
decisions.reason: To go out and come in before a people is to lead them in war and in peace, in all their affairs (Numbers 27:17; 1 Samuel 18:16; 1 Chronicles 11:2).

decisions.choice: judge: govern and settle disputes
decisions.reason: The king's judging includes ruling the people and deciding their cases with justice (1 Kings 3:9, 28).

decisions.choice: go out and come in ... as their leader (Balanced); lead (Readable)
decisions.reason: As in 1 Kings 3:7: Balanced keeps the picture and adds what it means; Readable says only what it means (m3).

decisions.choice: "salga y entre ... como su jefe" (B); "guiar" (R)
decisions.reason: To go out and come in before a people is to lead them (meaning decision); Balanced adds "como su jefe", as the Spanish of 1 Kings 3:7, and Readable says "guiar".

decisions.choice: maarifa
decisions.reason: The rare word for knowledge (m2) is "maarifa"; "ufahamu" is kept for "understanding" in the 1 Kings 3 parallel, and Chronicles uses another word.

decisions.choice: "đi ra đi vào ... mà lãnh đạo họ" (B); "lãnh đạo" (R)
decisions.reason: As 1 Kings 3:7: Balanced keeps the picture and adds what it means; Readable says only what it means (m3).

decisions.choice: "나가고 들어오며 그들을 이끌" (B); "이끌" (R)
decisions.reason: The idiom means to lead the people (m3), as the English Balanced and Readable make clear.

decisions.choice: sabedoria e conhecimento; sair e entrar à frente deste povo como o seu líder (B); liderar (R)
decisions.reason: "Sabedoria e conhecimento" for the pair Solomon asks for (m1, m2), the same two words through verses 11-12. The idiom (m3) keeps the words of 1 Kings 3:7 in Portuguese: Balanced keeps the picture and adds what it means, Readable says "liderar".

source.text: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר־אֱלֹהִ֣ים׀לִשְׁלֹמֹ֡ה יַ֣עַן אֲשֶׁר֩ הָיְתָ֨ה זֹ֜את עִם־לְבָבֶ֗ךָ וְלֹֽא־שָׁ֠אַלְתָּ עֹ֣שֶׁר נְכָסִ֤ים וְכָבוֹד֙ וְאֵת֙ נֶ֣פֶשׁ שֹׂנְאֶ֔יךָ וְגַם־יָמִ֥ים רַבִּ֖ים לֹ֣א שָׁאָ֑לְתָּ וַתִּֽשְׁאַל־לְךָ֙ חָכְמָ֣ה וּמַדָּ֔ע אֲשֶׁ֤ר תִּשְׁפּוֹט֙ אֶת־עַמִּ֔י אֲשֶׁ֥ר הִמְלַכְתִּ֖יךָ עָלָֽיו׃

records.literal_gloss: And said God to Solomon, Because that was this with your heart, and not you asked wealth, riches and honor, and [the] life of those hating you, and also days many not you asked, and you asked for yourself wisdom and knowledge that you may judge my people over which I have made you king,

en.L: And God said to Solomon, "Because this was in your heart, and you have not asked for wealth, riches and honor, or the life of those who hate you, and also have not asked for many days, but have asked for yourself wisdom and knowledge so that you may judge {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people over whom I have made you king,
en.B: God said to Solomon, "Because this was what your heart desired, and you have not asked for wealth, riches or honor, or the death of those who hate you, or even for a long life, but have asked for wisdom and knowledge so that you can judge {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people over whom I have made you king,
en.R: So God said to Solomon, "This is what you truly wanted. You did not ask to be rich or wealthy or honored. You did not ask {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} to kill those who hate you. You did not even ask to live a long time. Instead, you asked for wisdom and knowledge so that you can judge {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people, the people I have made you king over.

es.L: Y dijo Dios a Salomón: «Porque esto estuvo en tu corazón, y no pediste riquezas, bienes ni gloria, ni la vida de los que te aborrecen, y tampoco pediste muchos días, sino que pediste para ti sabiduría y conocimiento para juzgar a {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo, sobre el cual te he hecho rey,
es.B: Dios le dijo a Salomón: «Porque esto era lo que deseaba tu corazón, y no pediste riquezas, bienes ni gloria, ni la muerte de los que te odian, ni siquiera una larga vida, sino que pediste sabiduría y conocimiento para juzgar a {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo, sobre el cual te he hecho rey,
es.R: Entonces Dios le dijo a Salomón: «Esto es lo que de verdad querías. No pediste ser rico ni tener muchos bienes ni ser honrado. No me pediste que matara a los que te odian. Ni siquiera pediste vivir mucho tiempo. En cambio, pediste sabiduría y conocimiento para juzgar a {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo, el pueblo sobre el cual te he hecho rey.

fr.L: Et Dieu dit à Salomon : « Parce que c’est cela qui était dans ton cœur, et que tu n’as pas demandé la richesse, les biens et la gloire, ni la vie de ceux qui te haïssent, et que tu n’as pas non plus demandé de nombreux jours, mais que tu as demandé pour toi la sagesse et la connaissance afin de juger {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple sur lequel je t’ai fait régner,
fr.B: Dieu dit à Salomon : « Puisque c’est là ce que ton cœur désirait, et que tu n’as demandé ni la richesse, ni les biens, ni la gloire, ni la mort de ceux qui te haïssent, ni même une longue vie, mais que tu as demandé la sagesse et la connaissance pour pouvoir juger {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple, dont je t’ai fait roi,
fr.R: Alors Dieu a dit à Salomon : « Voilà ce que tu désirais vraiment. Tu n’as pas demandé d’être riche, d’avoir des biens ou d’être honoré. Tu ne {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}as pas demandé de faire mourir ceux qui te haïssent. Tu n’as même pas demandé de vivre longtemps. Au contraire, tu as demandé la sagesse et la connaissance pour pouvoir juger {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple, le peuple dont je t’ai fait roi.

sw.L: Mungu akamwambia Sulemani, "Kwa sababu jambo hili lilikuwa moyoni mwako, wala hukuomba mali, utajiri na heshima, wala roho za wale wanaokuchukia, wala hukuomba siku nyingi, bali umejiombea hekima na maarifa ili upate kuwahukumu watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} ambao nimekutawaza juu yao,
sw.B: Mungu akamwambia Sulemani, "Kwa kuwa hili ndilo moyo wako ulilolitamani, wala hukuomba mali, utajiri au heshima, wala kifo cha wale wanaokuchukia, wala hata maisha marefu, bali umeomba hekima na maarifa ili uweze kuwahukumu watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} ambao nimekufanya mfalme juu yao,
sw.R: Basi Mungu akamwambia Sulemani, "Hili ndilo ulilolitaka kweli. Hukuomba kuwa tajiri wala kuwa na mali wala kuheshimiwa. Hukuniomba niwaue wale wanaokuchukia. Hukuomba hata kuishi muda mrefu. Badala yake, umeomba hekima na maarifa ili uweze kuwahukumu watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}, watu ambao nimekufanya mfalme juu yao.

vi.L: Đức Chúa Trời phán với Sa-lô-môn: "Vì điều này đã ở trong lòng ngươi, và ngươi đã không xin của cải, giàu có và vinh hiển, hay mạng sống của những kẻ ghét ngươi, và cũng không xin sống lâu, nhưng đã xin cho mình sự khôn ngoan và sự hiểu biết để ngươi xét xử dân {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} mà {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã lập ngươi làm vua cai trị,
vi.B: Đức Chúa Trời phán với Sa-lô-môn: "Vì đó là điều lòng con mong muốn, và con đã không xin của cải, giàu sang hay vinh hiển, cũng không xin mạng sống của những kẻ ghét con, thậm chí không xin được sống lâu, nhưng đã xin sự khôn ngoan và hiểu biết để có thể xét xử dân {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, là dân mà {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã lập con làm vua cai trị,
vi.R: Vậy Đức Chúa Trời phán với Sa-lô-môn: "Đây là điều con thật lòng mong muốn. Con đã không xin được giàu có, sung túc hay được tôn trọng. Con đã không xin {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} giết những kẻ ghét con. Con cũng không xin được sống lâu. Trái lại, con đã xin sự khôn ngoan và hiểu biết để có thể xét xử dân {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, là dân mà {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã lập con làm vua cai trị.

ko.L: 그리고 하나님께서 솔로몬에게 말씀하셨다. "이것이 네 마음에 있어서, 네가 재물과 부와 영예와 너를 미워하는 자들의 목숨을 구하지 않았고, 또 많은 날도 구하지 않았으며, 내가 너를 왕으로 삼은 내 백성을 재판하려고 너를 위하여 지혜와 지식을 구했으므로,
ko.B: 하나님께서 솔로몬에게 말씀하셨다. "네 마음의 소원이 이것이어서, 재물이나 부나 영예나 너를 미워하는 자들의 죽음을 구하지 않고, 오래 살기도 구하지 않고, 오직 내가 너를 왕으로 세운 내 백성을 재판할 수 있도록 지혜와 지식을 구했으므로,
ko.R: 그러자 하나님께서 솔로몬에게 말씀하셨다. "이것이 네가 정말로 바라던 것이구나. 너는 부자가 되게 해 달라고 하지 않았다. 영예를 달라고 하지도 않았다. 너를 미워하는 자들을 죽여 달라고 하지도 않았다. 오래 살게 해 달라고 하지도 않았다. 그 대신에 너는 지혜와 지식을 구해서, 내가 너를 왕으로 세운 내 백성을 재판하려고 했다.

pt.L: E Deus disse a Salomão: "Porque isto estava no teu coração, e não pediste riqueza, bens e honra, nem a vida dos que te odeiam, e também não pediste muitos dias, mas pediste para ti sabedoria e conhecimento para julgares o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} povo, sobre o qual eu te fiz rei,
pt.B: Deus disse a Salomão: "Porque era isso que o teu coração desejava, e não pediste riquezas, bens ou honra, nem a morte dos que te odeiam, nem mesmo uma vida longa, mas pediste sabedoria e conhecimento para poderes julgar o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} povo, sobre o qual eu te fiz rei,
pt.R: Então Deus disse a Salomão: "Isto é o que tu querias de verdade. Tu não pediste para ser rico, nem para ter muitos bens, nem para receber honras. Não {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} pediste para matar os que te odeiam. Nem mesmo pediste para viver muito tempo. Em vez disso, pediste sabedoria e conhecimento para poderes julgar o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} povo, o povo sobre o qual eu te fiz rei.

decisions.choice: this was in your heart: this was what you truly wanted
decisions.reason: In Hebrew the heart is the seat of thought and will. To say that something was "with your heart" means that it was what Solomon really wished for and intended (compare 1 Chronicles 22:7; 28:2).

decisions.choice: God's answer, worded differently from 1 Kings 3:11
decisions.reason: 1 Kings 3:11 lists what Solomon did not ask in another order: long life, wealth, the life of his enemies. Chronicles puts wealth first, adds "riches" and "honor", says "those who hate you" for "your enemies", and puts long life last. Instead of "discernment to hear justice" it repeats "wisdom and knowledge", and it adds that Yahweh made Solomon king over his people.

decisions.choice: the life of those who hate you: their death
decisions.reason: To ask for someone's life is to ask that he be put to death (as in 1 Kings 3:11). The things Solomon did not ask for are the usual wishes of kings: riches, honor, victory over their foes and long life.

decisions.choice: wealth, riches: two words for possessions
decisions.reason: The first word is the usual word for wealth; the second, found also in Joshua 22:8 and Ecclesiastes 5:18; 6:2, means possessions or goods. Together they say "great riches".

decisions.choice: Because ... , (the sentence continues in verse 12)
decisions.reason: God's sentence runs into the next verse, where its main clause comes. Literal and Balanced end this verse with a comma; Readable makes short sentences of its own.

decisions.choice: ask {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} to kill those who hate you
decisions.reason: Readable says what asking for the life of enemies means (m3).

decisions.choice: "riquezas, bienes ni gloria" (L, B)
decisions.reason: Two words for possessions and one for honor (meaning decision); "gloria" for *kavod* follows the Spanish of 1 Kings 3:13, and Readable says "ser honrado".

decisions.choice: "la richesse, les biens et la gloire"
decisions.reason: Two words for possessions are kept apart as "richesse" and "biens"; "gloire" is the word French Kings uses for the same honor (1 Kings 3:13).

decisions.choice: mali, utajiri (Literal, Balanced); kuwa tajiri wala kuwa na mali (Readable)
decisions.reason: The two Hebrew words for possessions (m4) are "mali" and "utajiri", so that Swahili keeps two words as the Hebrew does.

decisions.choice: "của cải, giàu có" (L); "của cải, giàu sang" (B); "giàu có, sung túc" (R)
decisions.reason: Two Hebrew words for possessions (m4); Vietnamese keeps two words so that the list stays as long as the Hebrew's.

decisions.choice: The sentence runs on into verse 12 with "...구했으므로,"
alternatives: closing verse 11 as its own sentence
decisions.reason: As the English Literal and Balanced; Readable closes each clause.

decisions.choice: riqueza(s), bens
decisions.reason: The two words for possessions (m4) are "riqueza" and "bens", the second the ordinary Portuguese word for goods and property; "honra" as in 1 Kings 3:13 in Portuguese. Verse 12 repeats the three.

source.text: הַֽחָכְמָ֥ה וְהַמַּדָּ֖ע נָת֣וּן לָ֑ךְ וְעֹ֨שֶׁר וּנְכָסִ֤ים וְכָבוֹד֙ אֶתֶּן־לָ֔ךְ אֲשֶׁ֣ר׀לֹא־הָ֣יָה כֵ֗ן לַמְּלָכִים֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לְפָנֶ֔יךָ וְאַחֲרֶ֖יךָ לֹ֥א יִֽהְיֶה־כֵּֽן׃

records.literal_gloss: The wisdom and the knowledge [is] given to you; and wealth and riches and honor I will give to you, which not was so for the kings who [were] before you, and after you not will be so.

en.L: the wisdom and the knowledge [are] given to you; and wealth and riches and honor I will give you, such as the kings who [were] before you did not have, and after you none will have the like."
en.B: wisdom and knowledge are given to you. I will also give you wealth, riches and honor such as no king before you has had, and none after you will have."
en.R: So I am giving you wisdom and knowledge. I will also give you riches, wealth and honor. No king before you ever had so much, and no king after you will have as much."

fr.R: Alors je te donne la sagesse et la connaissance. Je te donnerai aussi la richesse, des biens et la gloire. Aucun roi avant toi n’en a jamais eu autant, et aucun roi après toi n’en aura autant. »

sw.B: umepewa hekima na maarifa. Nitakupa pia mali, utajiri na heshima ambavyo hakuna mfalme kabla yako aliyekuwa navyo, wala hatakuwepo baada yako atakayekuwa navyo."
sw.R: Basi ninakupa hekima na maarifa. Nitakupa pia utajiri, mali na heshima. Hakuna mfalme kabla yako aliyewahi kuwa navyo kwa wingi hivyo, wala hatakuwepo mfalme baada yako atakayekuwa navyo kwa kiasi hicho."

vi.L: sự khôn ngoan và sự hiểu biết [được] ban cho ngươi; và của cải, giàu có và vinh hiển {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} cũng sẽ ban cho ngươi, như các vua [đã ở] trước ngươi chưa hề có, và sau ngươi cũng sẽ không có như vậy."

vi.R: Vậy {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} ban cho con sự khôn ngoan và hiểu biết. Ta cũng sẽ ban cho con giàu có, sung túc và được tôn trọng. Chưa có vua nào trước con có nhiều như vậy, và sau con cũng sẽ không có vua nào được như vậy."

ko.L: 지혜와 지식이 네게 주어졌다. 그리고 재물과 부와 영예도 내가 네게 주겠다. 너보다 앞선 왕들에게도 이와 같은 것이 없었고, 네 뒤에도 이와 같은 것이 없을 것이다."
ko.B: 지혜와 지식을 네게 준다. 또 재물과 부와 영예도 네게 주겠다. 너보다 앞선 어떤 왕도 이런 것을 누리지 못했고, 네 뒤에도 누리지 못할 것이다."
ko.R: 그러므로 내가 너에게 지혜와 지식을 준다. 그리고 부와 재물과 영예도 주겠다. 너보다 앞선 어떤 왕도 이만큼 가지지 못했고, 네 뒤에 올 어떤 왕도 이만큼 가지지 못할 것이다."

pt.L: a sabedoria e o conhecimento [te são] dados; e riqueza, e bens, e honra eu te darei, como não tiveram os reis que [foram] antes de ti, e depois de ti não haverá assim."
pt.B: sabedoria e conhecimento te são dados. Também te darei riquezas, bens e honra, como nenhum rei antes de ti teve, e nenhum depois de ti terá."
pt.R: Por isso eu te dou sabedoria e conhecimento. Também vou te dar riquezas, bens e honra. Nenhum rei antes de ti teve tanto, e nenhum rei depois de ti vai ter tanto assim."

decisions.choice: given to you: already granted
decisions.reason: The word is a passive form, "given", that describes a settled fact. God grants the request as he speaks.

decisions.choice: none like you: 1 Kings 3:12-14 in other words
decisions.reason: In 1 Kings 3:12-13 God gives Solomon "a wise and discerning heart", says none before or after will be like him, and then adds wealth and honor. Chronicles says "wisdom and knowledge", and applies the comparison with kings before and after to the wealth and honor. It leaves out the promise of long life on condition of obedience (1 Kings 3:14).

decisions.choice: wealth, riches and honor: given freely
decisions.reason: Because Solomon did not ask for them, God gives them too. Verses 14-17 begin to show that this came true.

decisions.choice: the wisdom ... (lower case, continuing verse 11)
decisions.reason: This verse completes the sentence that began in verse 11, so Literal and Balanced continue it without a capital letter.

decisions.choice: No king before you ever had so much, and no king after you will have as much.
decisions.reason: Readable breaks the comparison into a sentence of its own.
