records.literal_gloss: And came Solomon to the high place that [was] at Gibeon, [to] Jerusalem, from before [the] tent of meeting, and he reigned over Israel.

en.L: And Solomon came [from] the high place that [was] at Gibeon to Jerusalem, from before the tent of meeting, and he reigned over Israel.
en.B: Then Solomon left the tent of meeting at the high place in Gibeon and came back to Jerusalem, and he reigned over Israel.
en.R: Then Solomon left the meeting tent at the hilltop shrine in Gibeon and went back to Jerusalem. And he ruled as king over Israel.

es.L: Y vino Salomón [desde] el lugar alto que [estaba] en Gabaón a Jerusalén, de delante de la Tienda del Encuentro, y reinó sobre Israel.
es.B: Después Salomón dejó la Tienda del Encuentro, en el lugar alto de Gabaón, y volvió a Jerusalén, y reinó sobre Israel.
es.R: Después Salomón dejó la Tienda del Encuentro, en el santuario sobre la colina de Gabaón, y volvió a Jerusalén. Y gobernó como rey sobre Israel.

fr.L: Et Salomon revint [du] haut lieu qui [était] à Gabaon à Jérusalem, de devant la tente de la Rencontre, et il régna sur Israël.
fr.B: Puis Salomon quitta la tente de la Rencontre, au haut lieu de Gabaon, et revint à Jérusalem ; et il régna sur Israël.
fr.R: Ensuite, Salomon a quitté la tente de la Rencontre, au sanctuaire sur la colline de Gabaon, et il est retourné à Jérusalem. Et il a régné sur Israël.

sw.L: Sulemani akaja [kutoka] mahali pa juu palipokuwa Gibeoni mpaka Yerusalemu, kutoka mbele ya Hema la Kukutania, akatawala juu ya Israeli.
sw.B: Kisha Sulemani aliondoka kwenye Hema la Kukutania mahali pa juu huko Gibeoni, akarudi Yerusalemu, akatawala juu ya Israeli.
sw.R: Kisha Sulemani aliondoka kwenye Hema la Kukutania katika patakatifu pa kilimani huko Gibeoni, akarudi Yerusalemu. Akatawala kama mfalme juu ya Israeli.

vi.L: Sa-lô-môn đi [từ] nơi cao [ở] tại Ga-ba-ôn về Giê-ru-sa-lem, từ trước Lều Hội Kiến, và vua trị vì trên Y-sơ-ra-ên.
vi.B: Rồi Sa-lô-môn rời Lều Hội Kiến tại nơi cao ở Ga-ba-ôn mà trở về Giê-ru-sa-lem, và vua trị vì trên Y-sơ-ra-ên.
vi.R: Rồi Sa-lô-môn rời Lều Hội Kiến tại nơi thờ phượng trên đồi cao ở Ga-ba-ôn và trở về Giê-ru-sa-lem. Vua cai trị trên Y-sơ-ra-ên.

ko.L: 그리고 솔로몬이 기브온에 있는 산당[에서], 회막 앞에서 떠나 예루살렘으로 와서, 이스라엘을 다스렸다.
ko.B: 그 뒤에 솔로몬은 기브온 산당에 있는 회막을 떠나 예루살렘으로 돌아와서 이스라엘을 다스렸다.
ko.R: 그 뒤에 솔로몬은 기브온의 산꼭대기 제단에 있던 회막을 떠나 예루살렘으로 돌아갔다. 그리고 왕으로서 이스라엘을 다스렸다.

pt.L: E Salomão veio [do] alto que [estava] em Gibeom a Jerusalém, de diante da tenda do encontro, e reinou sobre Israel.
pt.B: Então Salomão deixou a tenda do encontro, no alto de Gibeom, e voltou para Jerusalém. E reinou sobre Israel.
pt.R: Então Salomão deixou a tenda do encontro, no santuário no alto do morro em Gibeom, e voltou para Jerusalém. E governou como rei sobre Israel.

decisions.choice: from the high place
decisions.reason: The Hebrew reads "to the high place", which does not fit a journey from Gibeon to Jerusalem "from before the tent of meeting". The ancient Greek and Latin translations read "from", and the sense must be that, either because a letter was miscopied or because "came" here means "came back from [going] to". The meaning is not in doubt: Solomon returned from Gibeon.

decisions.choice: the return to Jerusalem: 1 Kings 3:15 told briefly
decisions.reason: 1 Kings 3:15 says that Solomon woke from the dream, came to Jerusalem, stood before the ark, made offerings and held a feast; then comes the case of the two women (3:16-28). Chronicles tells only the return and goes straight on to Solomon's wealth (verses 14-17), which shows God's promise of verse 12 coming true.

decisions.choice: and he reigned over Israel: the reign begins in earnest
decisions.reason: The clause sums up what follows: from Gibeon Solomon returns to rule, with the gift he asked for.

decisions.choice: left the tent of meeting at the high place in Gibeon and came back to Jerusalem
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable put the places in the order of the journey; the Hebrew names the high place, then Jerusalem, then the tent.

source.text: וַיֶּאֱסֹ֣ף שְׁלֹמֹה֮ רֶ֣כֶב וּפָרָשִׁים֒ וַֽיְהִי־ל֗וֹ אֶ֤לֶף וְאַרְבַּע־מֵאוֹת֙ רֶ֔כֶב וּשְׁנֵים־עָשָׂ֥ר אֶ֖לֶף פָּרָשִׁ֑ים וַיַּנִּיחֵם֙ בְּעָרֵ֣י הָרֶ֔כֶב וְעִם־הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ בִּירֽוּשָׁלִָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And gathered Solomon chariotry and horsemen, and was to him a thousand and four hundred chariot[s] and two [and] ten thousand horsemen, and he stationed them in [the] cities of the chariotry and with the king in Jerusalem.

en.L: And Solomon gathered chariots and horsemen; and he had 1,400 chariots and 12,000 horsemen, and he stationed them in the cities of the chariots and with the king in Jerusalem.
en.B: Solomon built up a force of chariots and horsemen. He had 1,400 chariots and 12,000 horsemen, which he stationed in the chariot cities and with the king in Jerusalem.
en.R: Solomon built up a large force of chariots and horsemen. He had 1,400 chariots and 12,000 horsemen. He kept some of them in the cities where his chariots were based, and some with him in Jerusalem.

es.L: Y juntó Salomón carros y jinetes; y tenía mil cuatrocientos carros y doce mil jinetes, y los puso en las ciudades de los carros y con el rey en Jerusalén.
es.B: Salomón reunió un ejército de carros y jinetes. Tenía 1400 carros y 12 000 jinetes, que estacionó en las ciudades de los carros y con el rey en Jerusalén.
es.R: Salomón reunió un gran ejército de carros de guerra y jinetes. Tenía 1400 carros y 12 000 jinetes. A algunos los tenía en las ciudades donde estaban sus carros, y a otros con él en Jerusalén.

fr.L: Et Salomon rassembla des chars et des cavaliers ; et il eut 1 400 chars et 12 000 cavaliers, et il les plaça dans les villes des chars et auprès du roi à Jérusalem.
fr.B: Salomon constitua une force de chars et de cavaliers. Il eut 1 400 chars et 12 000 cavaliers, qu’il installa dans les villes de garnison des chars et auprès du roi à Jérusalem.
fr.R: Salomon a rassemblé une grande armée de chars et de cavaliers. Il avait 1 400 chars et 12 000 cavaliers. Il en a gardé une partie dans les villes où étaient basés ses chars, et une partie avec lui à Jérusalem.

sw.L: Sulemani akakusanya magari ya vita na wapanda farasi; alikuwa na magari ya vita 1,400 na wapanda farasi 12,000, akawaweka katika miji ya magari ya vita na pamoja na mfalme huko Yerusalemu.
sw.B: Sulemani aliunda jeshi la magari ya vita na wapanda farasi. Alikuwa na magari ya vita 1,400 na wapanda farasi 12,000, aliowaweka katika miji ya magari ya vita na pamoja na mfalme huko Yerusalemu.
sw.R: Sulemani aliunda jeshi kubwa la magari ya vita na wapanda farasi. Alikuwa na magari ya vita 1,400 na wapanda farasi 12,000. Aliweka baadhi yao katika miji yalimokaa magari yake ya vita, na wengine pamoja naye huko Yerusalemu.

vi.L: Sa-lô-môn tập hợp xe chiến mã và kỵ binh; vua có 1.400 xe chiến mã và 12.000 kỵ binh, và vua đóng họ trong các thành để xe chiến mã và ở với vua tại Giê-ru-sa-lem.
vi.B: Sa-lô-môn xây dựng một lực lượng xe chiến mã và kỵ binh. Vua có 1.400 xe chiến mã và 12.000 kỵ binh, đóng tại các thành để xe chiến mã và ở với vua tại Giê-ru-sa-lem.
vi.R: Sa-lô-môn xây dựng một lực lượng lớn gồm xe chiến mã và kỵ binh. Vua có 1.400 xe chiến mã và 12.000 kỵ binh. Vua để một số ở các thành đóng quân xe chiến mã, và một số ở với vua tại Giê-ru-sa-lem.

ko.L: 그리고 솔로몬이 병거와 기병을 모았는데, 그에게는 병거 1,400대와 기병 1만 2천 명이 있었다. 그는 그들을 병거 성읍들과 예루살렘 왕의 곁에 두었다.
ko.B: 솔로몬은 병거와 기병을 모았다. 그에게는 병거가 1,400대, 기병이 1만 2천 명 있었는데, 그는 그들을 병거 성읍들과 예루살렘 왕의 곁에 두었다.
ko.R: 솔로몬은 병거와 기병을 많이 모았다. 그에게는 병거 1,400대와 기병 1만 2천 명이 있었다. 그는 그들 가운데 일부는 병거를 두는 성읍들에, 일부는 예루살렘에 자기 곁에 두었다.

pt.L: E Salomão ajuntou carros e cavaleiros; e ele tinha mil e quatrocentos carros e doze mil cavaleiros, e ele os alojou nas cidades dos carros e com o rei em Jerusalém.
pt.B: Salomão formou uma força de carros de guerra e cavaleiros. Tinha mil e quatrocentos carros e doze mil cavaleiros, que ele mantinha nas cidades dos carros e com o rei em Jerusalém.
pt.R: Salomão formou uma grande força de carros de guerra e cavaleiros. Ele tinha mil e quatrocentos carros e doze mil cavaleiros. Deixou uma parte deles nas cidades onde ficavam os seus carros, e outra parte com ele em Jerusalém.

decisions.choice: Solomon's chariots: the same words as 1 Kings 10:26
decisions.reason: Verses 14-17 repeat, almost word for word, 1 Kings 10:26-29, where they come near the end of Solomon's story; 2 Chronicles 9:25-28 has a similar summary. Placed here, right after the promise of verse 12, they show at once the wealth and honor God gave.

decisions.choice: horsemen: the men who rode or drove, or perhaps the horses themselves
decisions.reason: The word usually means horsemen, but it can also mean horses for chariots (as in 1 Kings 10:26; 5:6).

decisions.choice: the chariot cities: towns with stables and barracks for the chariot force
decisions.reason: Solomon built towns for his chariots and horsemen (8:6; 1 Kings 9:19).

decisions.choice: some ... and some with him
decisions.reason: As in 1 Kings 10:26: Readable says that the force was divided, and "with him" for "with the king".

decisions.choice: wording of 1 Kings 10:26 kept
decisions.reason: The Hebrew repeats 1 Kings 10:26 almost word for word (meaning decision), so the Spanish Kings wording is kept at each level.

decisions.choice: the wording of 1 Kings 10:26, unchanged; numbers in figures
decisions.reason: The Hebrew is the same as 1 Kings 10:26 (m1), so the Vietnamese of that verse is kept at each level. Numbers above a thousand are written in figures with a dot, as in Kings.

decisions.choice: The wording of 1 Kings 10:26 at each level
decisions.reason: The Hebrew of verses 14-17 is that of 1 Kings 10:26-29, so the Korean repeats that passage, changing only what the Hebrew changes.

decisions.choice: as 1 Kings 10:26
decisions.reason: Verses 14-17 repeat 1 Kings 10:26-29 (m1), and the Portuguese of 1 Kings is kept at every level. The numbers are round, so they are written in words, as there, where the English uses figures.

source.text: וַיִּתֵּ֨ן הַמֶּ֜לֶךְ אֶת־הַכֶּ֧סֶף וְאֶת־הַזָּהָ֛ב בִּירוּשָׁלִַ֖ם כָּאֲבָנִ֑ים וְאֵ֣ת הָאֲרָזִ֗ים נָתַ֛ן כַּשִּׁקְמִ֥ים אֲשֶׁר־בַּשְּׁפֵלָ֖ה לָרֹֽב׃

records.literal_gloss: And made the king the silver and the gold in Jerusalem like stones, and the cedars he made like the sycamores which [are] in the Shephelah, for abundance.

en.L: And the king made the silver and the gold in Jerusalem like stones, and the cedars he made like the sycamores that [are] in the Shephelah, for abundance.
en.B: The king made silver and gold as common in Jerusalem as stones, and he made cedar as plentiful as the sycamore-fig trees of the Shephelah.
en.R: The king made silver and gold as common in Jerusalem as stones. Cedar wood became as plentiful as the fig trees that grow in the western foothills.

es.L: E hizo el rey que en Jerusalén la plata y el oro fueran como piedras, y los cedros los hizo como los sicómoros que [hay] en la Sefela, en abundancia.
es.B: El rey hizo que en Jerusalén la plata y el oro fueran tan comunes como las piedras, y el cedro tan abundante como los sicómoros de la Sefela.
es.R: El rey hizo que en Jerusalén la plata y el oro fueran tan comunes como las piedras. La madera de cedro llegó a ser tan abundante como las higueras que crecen en las colinas del oeste.

fr.L: Et le roi rendit l’argent et l’or à Jérusalem [aussi communs] que les pierres, et il rendit les cèdres [aussi nombreux] que les sycomores qui [sont] dans la Shéfela, en abondance.
fr.B: Le roi rendit l’argent et l’or aussi communs à Jérusalem que les pierres, et le cèdre aussi abondant que les sycomores de la Shéfela.
fr.R: Le roi a rendu l’argent et l’or aussi courants à Jérusalem que les pierres. Le bois de cèdre est devenu aussi abondant que les figuiers qui poussent dans les collines de l’ouest.

sw.L: Mfalme akaifanya fedha na dhahabu katika Yerusalemu kuwa kama mawe, na mierezi akaifanya kuwa kama mikuyu iliyo katika Shefela, kwa wingi.
sw.B: Mfalme aliifanya fedha na dhahabu kuwa vya kawaida huko Yerusalemu kama mawe, na mierezi akaifanya kuwa mingi kama mikuyu ya Shefela.
sw.R: Mfalme aliifanya fedha na dhahabu kuwa vya kawaida huko Yerusalemu kama mawe. Mbao za mierezi zikawa nyingi kama mikuyu inayoota katika vilima vya magharibi.

vi.L: Vua làm cho bạc và vàng tại Giê-ru-sa-lem như đá, và gỗ bá hương vua làm cho như cây sung ở vùng Sơ-phê-la, vì rất nhiều.
vi.B: Vua làm cho bạc và vàng ở Giê-ru-sa-lem nhiều như đá, và gỗ bá hương nhiều như cây sung ở vùng Sơ-phê-la.
vi.R: Vua làm cho bạc và vàng ở Giê-ru-sa-lem nhiều như đá. Gỗ bá hương cũng nhiều như cây sung mọc ở vùng đồi phía tây.

ko.L: 그리고 왕이 예루살렘에서 은과 금을 돌처럼 [흔하게] 만들었고, 백향목을 세펠라에 있는 돌무화과나무처럼 많게 했다.
ko.B: 왕 덕분에 예루살렘에서는 은과 금이 돌처럼 흔해졌고, 백향목은 세펠라의 돌무화과나무처럼 많아졌다.
ko.R: 왕 덕분에 예루살렘에서는 은과 금이 돌처럼 흔해졌다. 백향목도 서쪽 낮은 산지에서 자라는 무화과나무처럼 많아졌다.

pt.L: E o rei fez a prata e o ouro em Jerusalém como as pedras, e os cedros ele fez como os sicômoros que [estão] na Sefelá, em abundância.
pt.B: O rei tornou a prata e o ouro tão comuns em Jerusalém como as pedras, e o cedro tão abundante como os sicômoros das colinas da Sefelá.
pt.R: O rei fez a prata e o ouro ficarem tão comuns em Jerusalém como as pedras. A madeira de cedro ficou tão abundante como as figueiras que crescem nas colinas do oeste.

decisions.choice: silver and gold: Chronicles adds the gold
decisions.reason: 1 Kings 10:27 and 2 Chronicles 9:27 say only that the king made silver like stones. This verse adds "and the gold"; the rest is the same.

decisions.choice: like stones, like the sycamores: a deliberate overstatement
decisions.reason: Stones lay everywhere in the hills of Judah. The verse says, with poetic exaggeration, that silver, gold and costly cedar from Lebanon became as common as the most ordinary things in the land.

decisions.choice: the sycamores in the Shephelah: common fig trees of the low hills
decisions.reason: The sycamore fig bears small figs and gives cheap, ordinary timber (Isaiah 9:9; Amos 7:14). The Shephelah is the region of low hills between the coastal plain and the hill country of Judah.

decisions.choice: sycamore-fig trees of the Shephelah (Balanced); fig trees that grow in the western foothills (Readable)
decisions.reason: As in 1 Kings 10:27: the English "sycamore" names a different tree, and Readable explains the Shephelah by where it lies.

decisions.choice: "los sicómoros de la Sefela" (B); "las higueras que crecen en las colinas del oeste" (R)
decisions.reason: As 1 Kings 10:27 in Spanish, with "y el oro", which Chronicles adds (meaning decision).

decisions.choice: "bạc và vàng"; otherwise 1 Kings 10:27
decisions.reason: Chronicles adds the gold (m1); the rest keeps the Vietnamese of 1 Kings 10:27, "cây sung" for the sycamore-fig and "vùng đồi phía tây" for the Shephelah at Readable.

decisions.choice: as 1 Kings 10:27, with "e o ouro"
decisions.reason: 1 Kings 10:27 in Portuguese at every level ("sicômoros", "as colinas da Sefelá", Readable's "colinas do oeste"), adding only the gold that Chronicles adds (m1).

source.text: וּמוֹצָ֧א הַסּוּסִ֛ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר לִשְׁלֹמֹ֖ה מִמִּצְרָ֑יִם וּמִקְוֵ֕א סֹחֲרֵ֣י הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ מִקְוֵ֥א יִקְח֖וּ בִּמְחִֽיר׃

records.literal_gloss: And [the] export of the horses which [were] to Solomon [was] from Egypt and from Kue; [the] traders of the king from Kue would take [them] at [a] price.

en.L: And the export of the horses that [were] Solomon's [was] from Egypt and from Kue; the traders of the king would take [them] from Kue at a price.
en.B: Solomon's horses were imported from Egypt and from Kue; the king's traders bought them from Kue at the going price.
en.R: Solomon's horses were brought in from Egypt and from Kue. The king's traders bought them in Kue and paid for them.

es.L: Y los caballos de Salomón [se traían] de Egipto y de Cue; los mercaderes del rey [los] compraban en Cue por un precio.
es.B: Los caballos de Salomón se importaban de Egipto y de Cue; los mercaderes del rey los compraban en Cue al precio corriente.
es.R: Los caballos de Salomón se traían de Egipto y de Cue. Los mercaderes del rey los compraban en Cue y los pagaban.

fr.L: Et la sortie des chevaux qui [étaient] à Salomon [était] d’Égypte et de Qoué ; les marchands du roi les prenaient à Qoué contre paiement.
fr.B: Les chevaux de Salomon venaient d’Égypte et de Qoué ; les marchands du roi les achetaient à Qoué au prix courant.
fr.R: Les chevaux de Salomon venaient d’Égypte et de Qoué. Les marchands du roi les achetaient à Qoué et les payaient.

sw.L: Na uletaji wa farasi waliokuwa wa Sulemani [ulikuwa] kutoka Misri na kutoka Kue; wafanyabiashara wa mfalme waliwanunua kutoka Kue kwa bei.
sw.B: Farasi wa Sulemani waliletwa kutoka Misri na kutoka Kue; wafanyabiashara wa mfalme waliwanunua kutoka Kue kwa bei ya soko.
sw.R: Farasi wa Sulemani waliletwa kutoka Misri na kutoka Kue. Wafanyabiashara wa mfalme waliwanunua huko Kue na kuwalipia.

vi.L: Ngựa của Sa-lô-môn được nhập từ Ai Cập và từ Cu-ê; các thương gia của vua mua [chúng] từ Cu-ê theo giá.
vi.B: Ngựa của Sa-lô-môn được nhập từ Ai Cập và từ Cu-ê; các thương gia của vua mua chúng tại Cu-ê theo giá thị trường.
vi.R: Ngựa của Sa-lô-môn được đem về từ Ai Cập và từ Cu-ê. Các thương gia của vua mua chúng tại Cu-ê và trả tiền đàng hoàng.

ko.L: 그리고 솔로몬의 말들은 이집트와 구에에서 들여왔는데, 왕의 상인들이 값을 치르고 구에에서 [그것들을] 사 왔다.
ko.B: 솔로몬의 말들은 이집트와 구에에서 들여왔다. 왕의 상인들이 구에에서 시세대로 값을 치르고 사 왔다.
ko.R: 솔로몬의 말들은 이집트와 구에에서 들여왔다. 왕의 상인들이 구에에서 값을 치르고 그 말들을 사 왔다.

pt.L: E a saída dos cavalos que [eram] de Salomão [era] do Egito e de Cue; os negociantes do rei [os] tomavam de Cue por um preço.
pt.B: Os cavalos de Salomão eram importados do Egito e de Cue; os negociantes do rei os compravam em Cue pelo preço corrente.
pt.R: Os cavalos de Salomão vinham do Egito e de Cue. Os negociantes do rei os compravam em Cue e pagavam por eles.

decisions.choice: the horse trade: the same words as 1 Kings 10:28
decisions.reason: The verse repeats 1 Kings 10:28; only the spelling of Kue differs slightly.

decisions.choice: Kue: a land in the south of present-day Turkey
decisions.reason: Kue is known from other ancient records as a land later called Cilicia, famous for its horses. The Hebrew vowels make the name look like a word for "a gathering", and older translations read it as "in droves" or "linen yarn" (see 1 Kings 10:28). The place name fits the trade route of verses 16-17.

decisions.choice: horses from Egypt: what the law warned a king against
decisions.reason: The law of the king told him not to gather many horses or send the people back to Egypt to get them (Deuteronomy 17:16), nor to gather much silver and gold (17:17). Here, as in Kings, the horses and gold are listed without comment.

decisions.choice: imported (Balanced); brought in (Readable); bought ... at the going price
decisions.reason: As in 1 Kings 10:28: the Hebrew "export" looks at the horses leaving their land; Balanced and Readable look at them arriving in Israel.

decisions.choice: as 1 Kings 10:28; Cue
decisions.reason: The verse repeats 1 Kings 10:28 (m1), and so does the Portuguese at every level, with the land's ancient name in the form "Cue" (m2).

source.text: וַֽ֠יַּעֲלוּ וַיּוֹצִ֨יאוּ מִמִּצְרַ֤יִם מֶרְכָּבָה֙ בְּשֵׁ֣שׁ מֵא֣וֹת כֶּ֔סֶף וְס֖וּס בַּחֲמִשִּׁ֣ים וּמֵאָ֑ה וְ֠כֵן לְכָל־מַלְכֵ֧י הַֽחִתִּ֛ים וּמַלְכֵ֥י אֲרָ֖ם בְּיָדָ֥ם יוֹצִֽיאוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: And they brought up and brought out from Egypt [a] chariot for six hundred silver, and [a] horse for fifty and hundred; and thus for all [the] kings of the Hittites and [the] kings of Aram, by their hand they would bring [them] out.

en.L: And they brought up and brought out from Egypt a chariot for 600 [shekels of] silver, and a horse for 150; and so for all the kings of the Hittites and the kings of Aram, by their hand they would bring [them] out.
en.B: They would import a chariot from Egypt for {{units:about 15 pounds|600 shekels}} of silver, and a horse for {{units:about 3 3/4 pounds|150 shekels}}. In the same way they exported them, through the king's traders, to all the kings of the Hittites and the kings of Aram.
en.R: A chariot from Egypt cost {{units:about 15 pounds|600 shekels}} of silver, and a horse cost {{units:about 3 3/4 pounds|150 shekels}}. The king's traders also sold horses and chariots to all the kings of the Hittites and of Aram.

es.L: Y subían y sacaban de Egipto un carro por seiscientos [siclos de] plata, y un caballo por ciento cincuenta; y así, por medio de ellos, [los] sacaban para todos los reyes de los hititas y para los reyes de Aram.
es.B: Un carro se importaba de Egipto por {{units:unos 7 kilos|seiscientos siclos}} de plata, y un caballo por {{units:1,7 kilos|ciento cincuenta siclos}}. De la misma manera, por medio de los mercaderes del rey, los exportaban a todos los reyes de los hititas y a los reyes de Aram.
es.R: Un carro de Egipto costaba {{units:unos 7 kilos|seiscientos siclos}} de plata, y un caballo {{units:1,7 kilos|ciento cincuenta siclos}}. Los mercaderes del rey también vendían caballos y carros a todos los reyes de los hititas y de Aram.

fr.L: Et ils faisaient monter et sortir d’Égypte un char pour six cents [sicles] d’argent, et un cheval pour cent cinquante ; et ainsi, pour tous les rois des Hittites et les rois d’Aram, ils les faisaient sortir par leur main.
fr.B: On importait d’Égypte un char pour {{units:environ 7 kilos|600 sicles}} d’argent, et un cheval pour {{units:environ 1,7 kilo|150 sicles}}. De la même façon, par l’intermédiaire des marchands du roi, on les exportait vers tous les rois des Hittites et les rois d’Aram.
fr.R: Un char venu d’Égypte coûtait {{units:environ 7 kilos|600 sicles}} d’argent, et un cheval {{units:environ 1,7 kilo|150 sicles}}. Les marchands du roi vendaient aussi des chevaux et des chars à tous les rois des Hittites et d’Aram.

sw.L: Wakapandisha na kutoa kutoka Misri gari la vita kwa [shekeli] 600 za fedha, na farasi kwa 150; na vivyo hivyo kwa wafalme wote wa Wahiti na wafalme wa Aramu, kwa mkono wao waliwatoa.
sw.B: Gari la vita lingeweza kuletwa kutoka Misri kwa {{units:karibu kilo 6.9|shekeli 600}} za fedha, na farasi kwa {{units:karibu kilo 1.7|shekeli 150}}. Vivyo hivyo, kupitia wafanyabiashara wa mfalme, waliwauzia wafalme wote wa Wahiti na wafalme wa Aramu.
sw.R: Gari la vita kutoka Misri liligharimu {{units:karibu kilo 6.9|shekeli 600}} za fedha, na farasi {{units:karibu kilo 1.7|shekeli 150}}. Wafanyabiashara wa mfalme waliwauzia pia farasi na magari ya vita wafalme wote wa Wahiti na wa Aramu.

vi.L: Họ đem lên và xuất từ Ai Cập một cỗ xe với giá 600 [siếc-lơ] bạc, và một con ngựa 150; cũng vậy, họ xuất chúng qua tay mình cho tất cả các vua người Hê-tít và các vua A-ram.
vi.B: Một cỗ xe nhập từ Ai Cập giá {{units:khoảng 6,9 kg|600 siếc-lơ}} bạc, và một con ngựa {{units:khoảng 1,7 kg|150 siếc-lơ}}. Cũng vậy, qua các thương gia của vua, họ xuất khẩu chúng cho tất cả các vua người Hê-tít và các vua A-ram.
vi.R: Một cỗ xe từ Ai Cập giá {{units:khoảng 6,9 kg|600 siếc-lơ}} bạc, và một con ngựa giá {{units:khoảng 1,7 kg|150 siếc-lơ}}. Các thương gia của vua cũng bán ngựa và xe cho tất cả các vua người Hê-tít và các vua A-ram.

ko.L: 그리고 그들이 이집트에서 병거를 은 600 [세겔에], 말을 150 [세겔에] 들여와 내보냈다. 이와 같이 헷 사람의 모든 왕과 아람의 왕들에게도 그들의 손으로 [그것들을] 내다 팔았다.
ko.B: 그들은 병거 한 대를 이집트에서 은 {{units:약 6.9킬로그램|600세겔}}에, 말 한 마리를 {{units:약 1.7킬로그램|150세겔}}에 들여왔다. 왕의 상인들은 또 이것들을 헷 사람의 모든 왕과 아람 왕들에게 내다 팔았다.
ko.R: 이집트에서 들여오는 병거 한 대 값은 은 {{units:약 6.9킬로그램|600세겔}}이었고, 말 한 마리 값은 {{units:약 1.7킬로그램|150세겔}}이었다. 왕의 상인들은 말과 병거를 헷 사람의 모든 왕과 아람 왕들에게도 팔았다.

pt.L: E faziam subir e sair do Egito um carro por seiscentos [siclos de] prata, e um cavalo por cento e cinquenta; e assim, para todos os reis dos hititas e para os reis de Arã, pela mão deles [os] faziam sair.
pt.B: Eles importavam do Egito um carro por {{units:cerca de 7 quilos|seiscentos siclos}} de prata, e um cavalo por {{units:cerca de 1,7 quilo|cento e cinquenta siclos}}. Do mesmo modo, por meio dos negociantes do rei, eles os exportavam para todos os reis dos hititas e para os reis de Arã.
pt.R: Um carro do Egito custava {{units:cerca de 7 quilos|seiscentos siclos}} de prata, e um cavalo custava {{units:cerca de 1,7 quilo|cento e cinquenta siclos}}. Os negociantes do rei também vendiam cavalos e carros a todos os reis dos hititas e de Arã.

decisions.choice: the prices of chariots and horses: 1 Kings 10:29
decisions.reason: 1 Kings 10:29 says "a chariot came up and went out from Egypt"; Chronicles says "they brought up and brought out", with the traders as subject. The prices and the trade with the north are the same.

decisions.choice: 600 of silver, 150: prices in shekels
decisions.reason: The Hebrew gives the numbers without the unit; the shekel is understood. A chariot cost four times as much as a horse.

decisions.choice: by their hand they exported: the king's traders sold them on
decisions.reason: "Their hand" refers to the king's traders of verse 16. Solomon's merchants acted as middlemen, selling horses and chariots to the kingdoms to the north.

decisions.choice: the kings of the Hittites and of Aram: the kingdoms of Syria
decisions.reason: The Hittites here are the small kingdoms of northern Syria that kept the Hittite name after the old Hittite empire fell. Aram is the land of the Arameans, north and east of Israel.

decisions.choice: 600 [shekels of] silver (Literal); about 15 pounds and about 3 3/4 pounds (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: Literal supplies "shekels" in brackets. Balanced and Readable give the weights in modern measure, with the shekels as the alternative.

decisions.choice: "unos 7 kilos" and "1,7 kilos" (metric); "seiscientos siclos", "ciento cincuenta siclos" (original)
decisions.reason: As 1 Kings 10:29 in Spanish: the units span gives metric weights by default, the shekel at 11,5 g, with the shekels as the alternative; Literal keeps the bare numbers as the Hebrew.

decisions.choice: karibu kilo 6.9; karibu kilo 1.7 (metric default); shekeli 600, shekeli 150 (alternative)
decisions.reason: As the Swahili style guide sets: the units setting defaults to metric (shekel 11.5 g), with the original unit as the alternative, where the English default is US pounds. Literal keeps the shekels in brackets.

decisions.choice: "khoảng 6,9 kg" and "khoảng 1,7 kg", with "600 siếc-lơ" and "150 siếc-lơ" as the alternative
decisions.reason: Metric by default (shekel 11,5 g), the shekels as the alternative, as in 1 Kings 10:29; the English converts to pounds. Literal keeps the shekels.

decisions.choice: "약 6.9킬로그램", "약 1.7킬로그램" (metric); "600세겔", "150세겔" (original)
decisions.reason: The shekel at 11.5 g, as in 1 Kings 10:29; Korean measures say "약 X", as the later terms notes set for the whole Bible.

decisions.choice: seiscentos [siclos de] prata (L); {{units:cerca de 7 quilos|seiscentos siclos}}, {{units:cerca de 1,7 quilo|cento e cinquenta siclos}} (B, R)
decisions.reason: 1 Kings 10:29 in Portuguese, with Chronicles' plural subject "faziam subir e sair" (L) and "eles importavam" (B) (m1). The weights are metric by default, at 11,5 grams to the shekel, with the shekels as the alternative, as there and in the Old Testament terms.

source.text: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר שְׁלֹמֹ֗ה לִבְנ֥וֹת בַּ֨יִת֙ לְשֵׁ֣ם יְהוָ֔ה וּבַ֖יִת לְמַלְכוּתֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: And said Solomon to build [a] house for [the] name of Yahweh and [a] house for his kingdom.

en.L: And Solomon said [he would] build a house for the name of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and a house for his kingdom.
en.B: Solomon decided to build a house for the name of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, and a palace for his own reign.
en.R: Solomon decided to build a temple where {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} would be worshiped, and a palace for himself as king.

es.L: Y dijo Salomón [que] edificaría una casa al nombre {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} y una casa para su reino.
es.B: Salomón decidió edificar una casa para el nombre {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} y un palacio para su reinado.
es.R: Salomón decidió construir un templo donde se adoraría {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} y un palacio para él como rey.

fr.L: Et Salomon dit [qu’il allait] bâtir une maison pour le nom {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} et une maison pour son royaume.
fr.B: Salomon décida de bâtir une maison pour le nom {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, et un palais pour son règne.
fr.R: Salomon a décidé de construire un temple où l’on adorerait {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, et un palais royal pour lui-même.

sw.L: Sulemani akasema [kwamba atajenga] nyumba kwa ajili ya jina la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, na nyumba kwa ajili ya ufalme wake.
sw.B: Sulemani aliamua kujenga nyumba kwa ajili ya jina la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, na ikulu kwa ajili ya utawala wake.
sw.R: Sulemani aliamua kujenga hekalu ambamo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} angeabudiwa, na ikulu yake mwenyewe kama mfalme.

vi.L: Sa-lô-môn truyền [lệnh] xây một nhà cho danh {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} và một nhà cho vương quyền mình.
vi.B: Sa-lô-môn quyết định xây một nhà cho danh {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} và một cung điện cho vương triều mình.
vi.R: Sa-lô-môn quyết định xây một đền thờ làm nơi thờ phượng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, và một cung điện cho chính mình là vua.

ko.L: 그리고 솔로몬이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 이름을 위한 집과 자기 나라를 위한 집을 짓겠다고 말했다.
ko.B: 솔로몬은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 이름을 위하여 집을 짓고, 자기 왕권을 위하여 궁전을 짓기로 했다.
ko.R: 솔로몬은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 예배할 성전을 짓고, 왕으로서 자기가 살 왕궁도 짓기로 했다.

pt.L: E Salomão disse [que ia] construir uma casa para o nome {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} e uma casa para o seu reino.
pt.B: Salomão decidiu construir uma casa para o nome {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} e um palácio para o seu próprio reinado.
pt.R: Salomão decidiu construir um templo onde {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} fosse adorado, e um palácio para ele mesmo como rei.

decisions.choice: verse numbers: in many Bibles this verse begins chapter 2
decisions.reason: This translation numbers verses as the Hebrew text does. In the Hebrew text chapter 1 ends with this verse, and chapter 2 begins with Solomon counting out his workers. Many Bibles number this verse 2:1, and so number Hebrew 2:1-17 as 2:2-18. The words are the same; only the numbers differ.

decisions.choice: said: decided, gave orders
decisions.reason: The verb is the common word for "say". Followed by "to build" it means that Solomon declared his intention and gave the word for it (compare 1 Chronicles 21:17; 1 Kings 5:19).

decisions.choice: a house for the name of Yahweh: the temple
decisions.reason: Yahweh had said that David's son would build a house for his name (1 Chronicles 17:12; 22:10). The name stands for Yahweh himself, present among his people and called on there (Deuteronomy 12:5, 11).

decisions.choice: a house for his kingdom: a royal palace
decisions.reason: "A house for his kingdom" means a palace for his reign as king. Its building is mentioned with the temple's in 7:11 and 8:1, and described in 1 Kings 7:1-12.

decisions.choice: house (Literal, Balanced), temple (Readable); house for his kingdom (Literal), palace for his own reign (Balanced), palace for himself as king (Readable)
decisions.reason: The same Hebrew word "house" is used for Yahweh's temple and for the king's palace. Balanced keeps "house" for Yahweh's and says "palace" for the king's; Readable says "temple" and explains "for the name of the LORD" (m3), as 1 Kings 3:2 does.

decisions.choice: said [he would] build
decisions.reason: Literal supplies words in brackets so that "said to build" reads as English.

decisions.choice: "casa" (L, B), "templo" (R); "una casa para su reino" (L), "un palacio para su reinado" (B), "un palacio para él como rey" (R)
decisions.reason: As the English (r-en-1) and the Kings terms note: the house of Yahweh is "casa" at Literal and Balanced and "templo" at Readable; the house for his kingdom is a royal palace.

decisions.choice: nyumba (Literal, Balanced), hekalu (Readable); ikulu for the king's house (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: As in the Swahili Kings drafts: the LORD's house is "nyumba" at Literal and Balanced and "hekalu" at Readable; the king's house is "ikulu", the ordinary word for a ruler's palace.

decisions.choice: "nhà" (L, B), "đền thờ" (R) for Yahweh's house; "nhà" (L), "cung điện" (B, R) for the king's
decisions.reason: One Hebrew word "house" for both; the wording kept from 1 Kings 3:1 and the terms note.

decisions.choice: "집" (L, B), "성전" (R); "나라를 위한 집" (L), "궁전" (B), "왕궁" (R)
decisions.reason: As in 1 Kings: 성전 where the English says "temple", 주의 집 elsewhere; 궁전 (B) and 왕궁 (R) for the palace.

decisions.choice: a casa (L, B), o templo (R); a casa do SENHOR (L, B)
decisions.reason: For the whole book, as 1 Kings 5:19 and 6:2 in Portuguese: Literal keeps the Hebrew "casa"; Balanced keeps "a casa" in the full phrases ("a casa do SENHOR", "a casa de Deus", "uma casa para o nome") and says "o templo" where "the house" alone names the building; Readable says "o templo". The king's house is "um palácio" at Balanced and Readable. Readable's "um templo onde o SENHOR fosse adorado" is the wording of 1 Kings 5:19.
